programme.title: 蕃尼蕃尼之嘉有好朋友
前途無量
programme.desc: 前途無量改編自小説錢途，由白宇王志飛董勇李乃文王宥鈞主演，是一部以現代職場為題材的電視劇該劇由多位實力派老劇骨出演，以生活化的劇情背景講述職場逆襲，內容精彩絕倫！故事講述林強（白宇飾）是聯眾銀行總行授信審批部的副總經理，他不願意為問題貸款簽字，因此得罪了上級領導，被貶到業績表現最差的龍源支行，與林強同期進入銀行的摯友鄭帥（王宥鈞 飾）也受到牽連，一起被降職龍源支行管理混亂不堪，林強以出眾的專業能力，迅速發現了龍源的問題所在，很快建立起了一支工作團隊，並協助支行的員工們爭取應有的利益林強的行動激怒行長郝偉（李洪濤飾），開始對他施加種種壓力林強陷入事業危機，別無選擇下進行反擊，他查明了貸款案的問題，並成功解決最終，林強不僅實現了職業理想，也為銀行行業重新確立了秩序和規則，維護銀行人的初衷，展現出一個逆襲的職場故事

programme.title: 前途無量
programme.desc: 前途無量改編自小説錢途，由白宇王志飛董勇李乃文王宥鈞主演，是一部以現代職場為題材的電視劇該劇由多位實力派老劇骨出演，以生活化的劇情背景講述職場逆襲，內容精彩絕倫！故事講述林強（白宇飾）是聯眾銀行總行授信審批部的副總經理，他不願意為問題貸款簽字，因此得罪了上級領導，被貶到業績表現最差的龍源支行，與林強同期進入銀行的摯友鄭帥（王宥鈞 飾）也受到牽連，一起被降職龍源支行管理混亂不堪，林強以出眾的專業能力，迅速發現了龍源的問題所在，很快建立起了一支工作團隊，並協助支行的員工們爭取應有的利益林強的行動激怒行長郝偉（李洪濤飾），開始對他施加種種壓力林強陷入事業危機，別無選擇下進行反擊，他查明了貸款案的問題，並成功解決最終，林強不僅實現了職業理想，也為銀行行業重新確立了秩序和規則，維護銀行人的初衷，展現出一個逆襲的職場故事

programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.title: YTN 24
programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

善德女王
programme.desc: 利用美色掌握宮中權力的美室，一心想成為王后，雖然摩耶王后在她的詭計下死裡逃生，還身懷六甲回到宮中，但摩耶王后懷的雙胞胎卻成就不幸的宿命，因為王室流傳一個預言御出雙生，聖骨男盡，意指王室若生出雙胞胎，將使王室男性斷了精氣真平王深知要是王后生下雙胞胎的事實曝光，一家人將會有無止盡的災難，於是命宮女昭火偷偷將其中一個女兒帶出王宮多年後被拋棄的公主德曼回到新羅，與雙胞胎姐姐天明公主同心協力對抗美室美室企圖用各種手段羅織罪名於德曼公主和天明公主，天明公主於一場追捕德曼的陰謀計畫下意外身亡，原本只想逃出新羅的德曼公主因為天明公主的死開始藉著聰慧的頭腦與身旁各方勢力的協助，最終擊垮政敵美室，成為第一個登上新羅王位的女性

programme.title: 包青天
programme.desc: 宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱包青天，為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調人在做天在看舉頭三尺有神明不畏強權，除惡務盡

programme.title: 紫釵奇緣
programme.desc: 紫釵一錯誤終身，才子佳人各天涯，情深難敵功名路，回首已成舊夢痕根據明代戲曲家湯顯祖的經典名著紫釵記改編而成，講述了大唐年間，歌舞名妓霍小玉風流俠客納蘭東書香才子李益和巾幗紅顏盧靖瀾為首的風騷人物，彼此錯綜複雜的命運與感情糾葛一場指腹為婚的誤會，造成浪漫卻無果的錯點鴛鴦，他們在階級差異與強權壓迫中勇於追求真愛，在宮廷權謀與世俗現實的拉扯中身不由己地被推向命運的叉路，自此展開一段關於愛背叛與救贖的傳奇故事

programme.title: 大漢盛世
programme.desc: 鐵腕定江山，仁德治天下，開創大漢文景盛世氣象西元201年，布衣天子劉邦擊敗西楚霸王項羽，建立了大漢王朝為鞏固皇權，誅滅韓信英布等異姓功臣，並應對匈奴威脅呂后專權後朝政動盪，直至誅呂之亂，性情仁厚長期鎮守代地的劉恒被推立為帝，是為漢文帝文帝即位後，以仁政安民，推行輕徭薄賦與民休息，抑制功臣與諸侯勢力，整頓吏治，重用賢才，推動農業與法制改革，同時安撫邊疆抵禦匈奴在權力與親情間多有取捨，含淚處置親族以穩國本最終奠定文景之治基礎，使漢室走向長治久安

programme.title: 大盛魁
programme.desc: 電視連續劇大盛魁由創業興業歇業三部一百集構成，歷史跨度270年由三個獨立完整的故事構成講述了王相卿張傑史大學等三個赤手空拳創業的故事

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫她看著失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中就像穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨時間隧道，一個叫若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內重生一場震動歷史的九龍奪嫡正暗潮湧動權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位阿哥們交織在一起她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有所愛的，也有愛她的若曦最後選擇的是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人？

programme.title: 縱橫四海
programme.desc: 三個相依為命的孤兒，在慧眼獨具的養父刻意培養下，成了國際通緝的頂尖大盜只是三人已厭倦了不能行走在陽光下的生活，而與養父約定了最後一次的任務，不料，祖（周潤發飾）卻在這次任務中葬身火海數年後，結為連理的占（張國榮飾）和紅豆（鍾楚紅飾）與祖歡喜重逢，就在三個人過著他們嚮往的太平生活時，養父突然出現，打破風雨前的寧靜

programme.title: 特務迷城
programme.desc: 夢想成為特務的小北（成龍飾），從小習武且有一點預知能力，憑著特長幫忙逮捕了銀行搶匪，不料因此開啟尋親與繼承遺產之旅然而，這一切竟然與美國政府失竊的炭疽菌有關！？

programme.title: 恐怖攻擊直播
programme.desc: 一位剛被降職而轉為主持廣播節目的主播尹榮華，某天接到不知名聽眾callin，恐嚇要脅若不回答問題或是掛電話，他將炸掉大橋，原以為只是無聊民眾的玩笑，沒想到就在掛掉電話後，他就親眼看見辦公大樓旁的跨海大橋遭到炸毀，該起恐怖攻擊造成無數傷亡！尹榮華意識到極可能是最近的連環爆炸事件主謀所為，於是緊急和電視台協議獨家直播該起爆炸案，企圖藉機讓自己重拾主播工作但接下來的直播過程卻漸漸開始失控

programme.title: 一八九五
programme.desc: 甲午戰爭清廷戰敗，同意將台灣割讓給日本1895年初夏，日本近衛軍團自台灣東北角登陸，準備接收台灣台灣士紳紛紛召募義勇軍積極備戰美麗的黃賢妹（楊謹華飾）曾遭土匪擄去，平安歸來後卻沒人相信她的清白秀才吳湯興（溫昇豪飾）不顧流言依約迎娶，信任與愛令黃賢妹銘感在心為了抗日，吳湯興投筆從戎，組成了客家義民軍，率領客家男丁為保家衛國而奮戰，黃賢妹則與全村女眷共同染衣耕作，作為他的強力後盾

programme.title: 正宗絕代雙驕
programme.desc: 移花宮主（張敏）新任武林至尊，誓要殺盡十大惡人，而與丈夫燕南天反目燕雖退敵但慘變植物人，惡人李大咀及屠嬌嬌遂將燕之子撫育成人，改名小魚兒（劉德華），宮主則收養女嬰花無缺（林青霞）培植她做接班人十八年後，小魚兒與花無缺在賞善罰惡大會上相遇，展開糾纏的命運

programme.title: 開心鬼
programme.desc: 一名多次赴考未中狀元的古人，懸樑自盡後附於麻繩上，而意外來到八十年代，遇上一群女學生成為好友，也因此鬧出許多笑話

programme.title: 臨時劫案
programme.desc: 兩個頹廢中年難兄難弟慕容輝笠水計劃搶劫，卻意外遇到真正悍匪梅藍天，陰差陽錯間三人臨時組隊打劫贓款，不料錢款早已被捷足先登，一時間匪徒各懷鬼胎，互相吞併，與此同時女警探姜姐也將三人鎖定，槍戰搶錢一觸即發，臨時劫案誰生誰死誰破案

programme.title: 賭俠大戰拉斯維加斯
programme.desc: KING與化骨龍成為老千拍檔，加上化骨龍的表哥阿叻，三人合力在大惡人大眼文的地下賭場騙了一大筆錢，準備去風流快活，不料大眼文派人追殺，在海邊酒店擄走化骨龍KING及阿叻被警方邀往拉斯維加斯協助辦案，欲捉拿大老千Peter朱KING使用奇謀妙計，不但順利將Peter朱帶回香港，並起回四十億贓款！

programme.title: 潛行
programme.desc: 時代在不斷前進，警方與毒販間的禁毒戰爭也面臨新的挑戰，隱蔽的暗網成為新一代毒品販售的溫床，而它的目標正是位於亞太中心的香港，一批重達4噸的毒品趁著超強颱風的掩護秘密入港，準備在網絡上展開狂歡式銷售，情況緊迫，警方必須找出掌控暗網的幕後老闆，只能將藏身已久的臥底警員推到前線，然而老闆的身份仍然成謎，臥底警員陷入危險之中，毒品網絡蠢蠢欲試，警方和犯罪集團陷入一場宿命般的對決

programme.title: 李洛夫奇案
programme.desc: 一九五七年，香港黑社會猖獗，政府當局派李洛夫前往英國深造，待其返港後成立反黑組，與黑道勢力展開對決

programme.title: 東方禿鷹
programme.desc: 美利堅合眾國國防部1987年第一號秘密軍事行動代號東方禿鷹行動執行者林中校於聯邦監獄抽選一批華裔刑事重犯組成雜牌軍，負責明修棧道之任務；楊上校則率領華裔精練部隊負責暗渡陳倉任務但上帝未眷顧此一行動，在空難事故中，精練部隊出師未捷身先死，林中校唯有率領雜牌軍空降北越，強渡關山，向死神挑戰

programme.title: 暗戰2
programme.desc: 神秘罪犯伊健與警察何尚生展開取贖金遊戲兩人初次交手，便發現雙方實力旗鼓相當之後，尚生根據伊健破壞的藝術品，推斷出伊健有意勒索保險公司伊健向該保險公司高層美女Teresa勒索，並要求她親自送錢，於是他們開始了第二次交手Teresa按照伊健指定的路線送錢，沿途留下標記供尚生追蹤，伊健與尚生面臨著第三次的交鋒

programme.title: 歲月風雲之上海皇帝
programme.desc: 陸月生本是小販出身，因用流氓手法偵破宋教仁被刺案而聲名大噪，受到法租界總探長黃全榮賞識，從此平步青雲，依附軍閥勢力，逐步攀升成為上海大亨但好景不長，1927年，上海迎來前所未有的社會動盪與政治鉅變，軍閥割據，民不聊生，國共反目，工人造反，陸月生最終被國民黨利用，參與了反對鎮壓工人武裝的鬥爭與屠殺共產黨人的陰謀

programme.title: 警察故事III超級警察
programme.desc: 陳家駒遠赴大陸臥底打入國際軍火毒品走私集團內部，在美女公安楊建華的幫助下，順利接近了正在服刑的集團成員豹強，密謀越獄成功建華自稱家駒妹妹同行，來到香港加入販毒集團，集團老大猜霸帶領手下赴吉隆坡營救被綁架的妻子，不料家駒與建華之臥底身份被揭發，被迫與集團展開連番惡鬥

programme.title: 武狀元蘇乞兒
programme.desc: 滿清年間，旗人子弟蘇察哈爾燦目不識丁揮霍成性為贏得丐幫美女如霜芳心，決定上京考武狀元蘇父買通考官由師爺代筆考中武狀元，但被臥底宮中之天理教教主趙無忌揭發舞弊皇帝怒將燦父子貶為乞丐流落街頭，燦又遭趙無忌打成殘廢後燦偶遇丐幫長老洪日慶授以睡夢羅漢拳，如霜被趙無忌擄走，燦以睡夢羅漢拳奪得幫主之位，率眾迎戰造反之趙無忌，終於領悟降龍十八掌

programme.title: 急凍行者上
programme.desc: 錦衣衛高手賀英奉皇帝之命前往天竺國曾歃血為盟的兄弟元龍聶虎和薩獒，在賀英歸來途中對他展開突襲，而一陣地動山搖引來巨大雪崩，將四人一併淹沒400年後，被意外解凍的賀英來到了現代社會，但聶虎薩獒元龍三人也相繼從冰封中解凍，他們為了各自的目的不停追捕賀英，四兄弟之間的秘密也相繼揭開

programme.title: 六扇門 7-9 首
programme.desc: 六扇門 7-9 首

programme.title: 急凍行者下
programme.desc: 明朝將軍賀英阿狗與聶虎來到現在香港，經歷青馬大橋之戰，最終阿狗死去，而賀英與阿虎則被警方扣查從明朝來到現代的副警務署張一鳴帶走賀英與阿狗，藉賀英手上的時空金碟回到明朝，而賀英選擇回到桃源村的道路，卻影響了他與其他相關人等的往後命運

programme.title: 談判專家首
programme.desc: 談判專家卓文偉意外成為一樁命案的頭號嫌犯，被逼無奈下他占領警署挾持員警作人質，並指定前談判專家謝家俊與自己對話，擅長攻心的謝家俊與技巧高超的卓文偉反復拉鋸，唇槍舌戰間，兩人的立場與心態逐漸發生改變

programme.title: 摔角王：風雲再起
programme.desc: 他已故的父親身兼東加王國男爵與知名摔角冠軍兩大頭銜，在返鄉處理遺產時竟捲入黑白兩道衝突，他必須為了奪回父親被盜的冠軍腰帶而奮鬥！

programme.title: 跟著IKEA衣櫥去旅行
programme.desc: 阿賈是來自孟買的街頭魔術師，當他的母親過世後，他決定前往巴黎尋找他未曾謀面的生父阿賈抵達巴黎，卻窮到只能躲進IKEA的衣櫥中過夜，沒想到竟連人帶衣櫥被送往了英國，還被警方當成非法移民遭逢致命的危險，後又輾轉到了義大利羅馬跟女明星奈莉有了難解之緣，阿賈還冒險登上熱氣球飛越地中海沒想到一段超展開的意外旅程幾個萍水相逢的異國人，最後卻幫助他找到了真正的自己

programme.title: 騙局
programme.desc: 安端羅卡是一位家族企業的老闆，因經營不善而申請破產，但無意中得知公司未用罄的碳排放量配額可以變現！這讓他想出了一個點子：成立空殼公司透過稅法漏洞進行碳排放量配額買賣，進而賺取消費稅差額這個歪主意雖然讓他大筆進帳，並順利買回破產的公司，卻也為他和周遭的好友們引來一連串殺身之禍

programme.title: 水星任務
programme.desc: 突然從天而降的大量金屬碎片引發民眾恐慌，經檢驗後發現是來自水星的磁化殘骸；同時一名科學家收到正在執行水星任務的妻子突然失聯的消息，心急如焚的他自製接收器，意外收到來自妻子發出的訊號，整合所有資訊後竟發現，地球將在18小時內與水星相撞！

programme.title: 時空交戰
programme.desc: 二位上古神明和敵人對戰時，意外在時空漩渦中墜落，發現自己身處當今世界只有一名年輕女孩，據說她的眼睛可以看清一切並擁有強大的力量，只有她才能送他們回自己的時空以拯救諸神人類還有動物；否則所有生命皆將逝去

programme.title: 神鬼二勢力
programme.desc: 兩位出沒於墨西哥的辣妹俠盜以銀行為目標，劫富濟貧頻頻得手，成為家喻戶曉的傳奇而她們真正的敵人，其實是已將魔爪漸漸深入小鎮的邪惡勢力！

programme.title: 小麻煩當家
programme.desc: 嬌生慣養養尊處優的狗狗小麻煩從小過著皇帝般的幸福生活不料女主人突然過世，牠被迫流落街頭，忍受風吹雨打日曬雨淋；某天牠意外找到了一位新主人：一位立志當歌手的年輕女孩，人狗之間一拍即合，從此相依為命，一同面對各種逆境，朝夢想邁進！

programme.title: 瞞天機密
programme.desc: 在英國情報機構任職的中文翻譯員凱薩琳，某天收到一封讓她備感震驚的電子郵件，內容顯示美國國安局為使聯合國安理會同意發動伊拉克戰爭，竟串通英國政府執行非法行動，企圖改變聯合國表決結果凱薩琳向媒體揭發此事，成功引發世界輿論的關注與譴責在此同時，她也因為違反國家機密法而遭控叛國罪她該如何對抗這個不公不義的政府？而這個世界又將如何回應她的勇氣呢？

programme.title: 36總局
programme.desc: 巴黎街頭出現一群窮凶惡極的匪徒，犯下多起血腥暴力的攻擊事件，警方卻遲遲抓不到兇手警界盛傳只要將這幫惡人緝拿歸案，就能接替巴黎刑警局局長之大位而警局裡最有勝算的兩大警探，里奧為求破案不惜包庇線人，卻意外捲入謀殺案；丹尼則因過於服從上級，導致隊友因公殉職激烈的爭權鬥勢，讓他們兩人迷失在道德邊界，這場權力戰爭將何去何從？

programme.title: 極地追擊
programme.desc: 美國懷俄明州印第安自治區，偏僻荒涼，律法難以管控，許多謀殺案件層出不窮獵人柯瑞（傑瑞米雷納飾）和FBI探員珍（伊莉莎白歐森飾）共同調查一宗當地少女謀殺案，兩種完全不同的文化背景和社會形態，漸漸走入充滿人性掙扎的迷霧當中，隨著複雜脈絡的揭開，兇案真相也逐漸顯現

programme.title: 荒野大決鬥
programme.desc: 農夫亨利和他的兒子住在鄉間農場，某日他們發現一位垂死的受傷男子，就收留並將他從鬼門關前救了回來，同時也發現男子攜帶的袋子裡裝了滿滿的現金隨後，一群冒充執法人員的歹徒來到農場要找那神秘男子與錢，就包圍了農場亨利被迫做出選擇為了守護他的家，亨利展現了他的槍法，眾人感到驚訝之餘，也開始懷疑亨利的真實身分

programme.title: 終極聖徒
programme.desc: 他曾受汙名指控並遭監禁，後來化名為耶穌會士當他發現妻子遭到謀殺兒子被綁架至墨西哥時，他擬定了一個詭譎危險的計劃，試圖營救他的兒子，並為死去的妻子報仇

programme.title: 超電網戰將
programme.desc: 一名半退休刺客和一名緝毒局探員在各自的任務中巧遇，他們試圖阻止一個網路恐怖組織的陰謀，該組織建造了一台危險裝置並要脅攻擊電網，意欲帶給全世界無法預期的可怕災難

programme.title: 巨蛛魔
programme.desc: 單親媽媽凱拉為了生計，帶著一雙兒女搬到鄉下，為多發性硬化症的克拉克擔任私人看護，這位富有的雇主病發前是位國際知名古物鑑定家，兒子傑西無意間發現沃爾特藏在家中的神秘傳說，由古老的黑暗和純粹的本能而生的超自然力量，孕育了超巨大洞穴蜘蛛，可怕的是，人類是牠們的最愛！

programme.title: 好萊塢幕後解密新
programme.desc: 好萊塢幕後解密新

programme.title: 致命遺產
programme.desc: 和父親斷聯許久的貝拉剛假釋出獄，接到父親好友艾德告知父親已經過世，並留給她一艘豪華遊艇前去領取父親最後禮物的貝拉，在酒吧裡邂逅了天菜麥可，一夕間猶如美夢成真！此時遊艇卻遭到兩名不速之客入侵，貝拉轉眼身陷巨大危機，在大海中退無可無退的她，不得不為生存而戰，並挖掘出謎樣父親的秘密

programme.title: 戰狼部隊1：同袍回歸
programme.desc: 戰狼部隊隸屬於警察特種部隊無線電偵查小組，是小組中最傑出強悍的一支部隊此次任務是前往一處遭恐怖份子劫持的學區，解救被迫成為人質的市長與學生們

programme.title: 戰狼部隊2：危險行動
programme.desc: 喬與波聯手欲逮捕在馬爾丁郊外的恐怖份子巴赫茲，參與這場武裝護衛行動的每位成員都將承受恐怖威脅的挑戰戰狼部隊此番行動將面臨滂沱大雨以及潛伏於內部的陰謀，同時必須成功移送未知的恐怖份子

programme.title: 戰狼部隊3：千鈞一髮
programme.desc: 戰狼部隊因檢察公署的行政考量，遭強制重組成兩支小隊，一隊負責與特種部隊和喬聯合打擊內部叛徒，另一隊則留在伊斯坦堡恐怖份子包圍了圖然與卡雅，雅伊木蘭特必須在有限的援助下，設法前往阿巴斯泰佩救出他的部隊

programme.title: 反恐行動：獨立日
programme.desc: 12月6日是芬蘭的國慶日：獨立日，但今年顯得特別不平靜，總統官邸遭到恐怖份子襲擊，連總統在內的大批貴賓遭挾持成為人質！安全情報局幹員麥克斯被指派為這場人質危機的談判專家，他必須採取大膽行動，找出幕後真凶不僅人命關天，甚至整個歐洲的未來安危都肩負在麥克斯身上！

programme.title: 下一站，托斯卡尼
programme.desc: 一位畫家，帶著他關係疏遠的兒子，兩人從倫敦返回義大利，想出售已故妻子多年前一起生活過的房子不過這棟房子年久失修，客廳牆壁還有一大片難以理解的彩繪，導致完全沒人想買下這棟房子兩人只好試圖與當地居民，一同運用手邊僅有的工具，開始修繕這棟老舊房屋同時，這對父子也沒想到，當他們放下繁忙生活，來到義大利托斯卡尼鄉間，似乎也開始找到屬於他們的未來

programme.title: 美聲歌雞
programme.desc: 圖魯是一隻相貌古怪且不會下蛋的母雞，因此遭到其他母雞的嘲笑和排擠曾是音樂老師的老奶奶伊莎貝爾非常喜歡圖魯，她將圖魯帶到自己的農場，竟意外發現圖魯的獨特天賦她不僅能夠跟人類說話，還有著美麗的動人歌聲，但伊莎貝爾害怕其他人會利用圖魯的天賦賺錢，於是決定守住這個秘密某天，伊莎貝爾從屋頂上摔下來而且失去了記憶，隨後被救護車送往醫院；想念老奶奶的圖魯決定踏上旅程尋找她珍貴的好友！

programme.title: 雷霆殺陣
programme.desc: 米榭爾維隆是個賽車天才，儘管家人持反對意見，米榭爾始終追求自己的理想，那就是一定要取得利曼24小時耐力賽冠軍憑藉著熱情與堅強體魄，以及冷靜的分析判斷能力，米榭爾終於拿到了這項比賽的冠軍一時媒體和車迷都奉他為世界賽車的未來天皇巨星就在各種鮮花喜悅包圍著米榭爾的同時，一場跨國的獵殺行動也悄悄展開

programme.title: 疾凍救援
programme.desc: 在加拿大北部一處偏僻的鑽石礦坑發生重大坍塌意外，一群礦工被埋在坑道內，僅剩30小時的氧氣可以存活一支緊急救難隊靠著巨型卡車橫越300英哩結冰湖面構成冰路，救出被困住的26名礦工但他們真正的威脅卻是過去從未遇過的恐怖危機，原來礦坑企業公司為了隱藏爆炸意外主因被揭發，竟雇用大批殺手阻撓救難隊員行進，一場驚天動地的救難行動在冰天雪地中就此展開！

programme.title: 李祘1-2
programme.desc: 李祘1-2

programme.title: 偷龍轉鳳
programme.desc: 妮可是巴黎著名的邦尼家族千金，但邦尼家族私下係以偽造名家藝術贗品為樂巴黎一所博物館將舉行藝術品展覽，妮可的父親受邀參加，然而其中被視為偉大傑作的維納斯雕像，其實是她祖父製造的贗品，投保一百萬美元不料，保險公司要求技術鑑定，眼看事蹟即將敗露，妮可只得聘請一位高明神偷賽門偷走雕像

programme.title: 黃飛鴻
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻李連杰飾常教人練武可自強救國，但見政府苟且，洋人橫行，民間私鬥，漸覺武術不可解國困沙河市黑幫到戲班收取保護費，衍生連串風波戲班開鑼日，鴻被人追殺，死傷無數提督大怒，要查封寶芝林及逮捕鴻，鴻答允救治傷者後投案沙河幫並將十三姨關之琳飾擄走，鴻與寬合力救出十三姨，寬亦拜鴻為師，從此隨鴻學藝

programme.title: 江湖女間諜
programme.desc: 來自愛爾蘭的瑪麗亞一號，從小隨著革命家父親為反對英國統治而四處進行破壞一次行動中父親不幸喪命，她誤打誤撞躲藏在馬戲團，遇到法國來的瑪麗亞二號為了幫她逃避英軍追捕，兩個瑪麗亞結成表演組合，因大膽表演迅速爆紅一次表演後，瑪麗亞二號邂逅了革命首腦弗洛雷斯並為其偉大情操打動，但弗洛雷斯卻不幸被獨裁者追捕射殺，瑪麗亞二號便繼承其遺志，號召村民展開抗爭，瑪麗亞一號也憑多年經驗來幫助平民百姓

programme.title: 追男仔
programme.desc: 單親爸爸程勝獨力撫養三個女兒長大成人，假稱患上絕症對女兒們催婚精英女警與男公關善良社工與古惑仔醫生與純情少爺，三對冤家笑料百出，是否能修成正果呢？

programme.title: 大進擊
programme.desc: 二戰期間，英國轟炸中隊於巴黎上空執行轟炸任務，其中一架轟炸機被德軍擊中，飛行員被迫跳傘逃生，並約好在清真寺旁的土耳其浴室會合其中三名英軍分別降落在動物園水池歌劇院，以及正在重新粉刷的納粹祕密警察總部屋頂，在動物園管理員歌劇院樂團指揮與油漆工幫助下逃生而樂團指揮和油漆工，更陰錯陽差隨著三名英軍飛行員，與德軍展開了一場場驚險刺激的逃亡之旅！

programme.title: 荒野一匹狼

programme.title: 誅仙
programme.desc: 十多年前，草廟村巨變慘遭毀村之災小凡驚羽兩人幸運逃過一劫，被青雲門大竹峰收留，但小凡資質駑鈍，只能淪為打雜為了不讓進度落後的小師弟受到父親責罰，田靈兒總是偷偷教小凡心法，致小凡對靈兒產生好感，然靈兒已有心儀之人，忌妒使得小凡悲喜無常，更引發一場人魔之戰

programme.title: 天際英豪
programme.desc: 韋吉希赫庫斯是土耳其航空史上的先驅發明家工程師，也是土耳其第一位設計製造飛機的軍官，這是首次將他的故事搬上大螢幕1912年，26歲的他將心力全部放在飛行上，他的精神影響了後世，一直延續到現在的穆罕默德和塞林身上，他們追隨韋吉希的腳步，設計飛機，朝著自己的夢想前進

programme.title: 廟街十二少
programme.desc: 他沒有姓名，人們都稱他十二少，因為他有十二個叱吒黑白兩道的乾爹乾媽，表面上他是天之驕子，但他的內心比誰都寂寞某天，十二少遇見一個改變他一生的女人霍德蘭，他們是兩個極端世界的人，但一段真摯浪漫的愛情偏偏在他們之間發生

programme.title: 黃昏三鏢客
programme.desc: 好人壞人小人，三名主角在美國南北戰爭時期，為了南方政府埋藏的一批黃金，展開爾虞我詐勾心鬥角的驚天對決

programme.title: 古董局中局
programme.desc: 來自日本的木戶加奈小姐即將歸還中國一尊唐代武則天時期的明堂佛頭，指明要文物界組織五脈旗下白字門許家後人出面接收有著一身鑒古天賦的許家後人許願，在黃煙煙勸說下，他不情願的前往交涉，卻敏銳地察覺到佛頭是贗品許願本想逃避，然而面對重重迷霧和威脅，已是身不由己他必須要在各方勢力的糾纏之下，查明真相

programme.title: 飛行世紀
programme.desc: 二十世紀初萊特兄弟成功實現了人類飛行的夢想，英國每日郵報主編羅恩斯利為了彰顯大不列顛帝國的種族優越，便策劃了一場從倫敦飛往巴黎的飛行競賽，但他其實私下盤算讓準女婿梅斯贏得比賽來自世界各地的飛行愛好者帶著自己的愛機湧入倫敦參加比賽，此時邪惡的波西先生和助手卻開始進行破壞和作弊計畫這場冒險者的比賽，意外發展成了一場爭奪羅恩斯利女兒帕崔夏的愛情大賽！

programme.title: 吊人索
programme.desc: 退休警官杰德庫柏來到西部購買一批牲口準備務農，卻被一群以退役上尉威爾遜為首自稱為民除害的槍手，指控其謀殺及偷竊牛隻，而私下對他處以絞刑庫柏瀕死之際被經過的法警救下，而真實的犯案者也在事後被逮，法官除還庫柏清白外，更力邀庫柏重回警職擔任警長，成為美國西部聯邦法警庫柏決心整治濫用私刑問題為嫌犯爭取公平審判，並將那班原欲吊死他的惡徒一一繩之以法

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.desc: 渣男律師劈腿富豪千金 李敏英逆襲成知名設計師恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 全台首播心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.title: 整形過後--慾望與認同
programme.desc: 台灣首部整形醫療影集整形過後，整的不只是臉，而是心！！華麗卻殘酷的醫美產業，揭開變美的創傷與代價技術頂尖卻內心破碎的整形外科醫師江浩宇，遇上正直倔強從公立醫院轉來的楊雅頌，被迫直視醫療倫理與八年前未解的傷痛兩人與診所執行長蘇菲，交織出情感與權力的拉扯一樁樁醫美案例浮上檯面，被控制的女星術後猝死的公關非法醫療與重建自我的病人，不斷拷問真正的治療是什麼這是一段關於修復放下與重生的故事

programme.title: 女人要有錢
programme.desc: 知名女作家吳淡如，以她知性且深入人心的形象，攜手專業寶物鑑定團隊，帶領觀眾走進藝人名人貴婦及素人家中，鑑賞他們珍藏的寶物及收藏品節目將通過生動的賞寶過程，向觀眾傳授基礎的賞寶知識，讓大家在輕鬆愉快的氛圍中，學會如何鑑定家中的寶物究竟這些珍藏能否讓你一夜致富，還是讓你瞬間崩盤？敬請鎖定，一同探索古今寶物的奧秘！

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 2023紅星大獎獲最佳電視劇 自閉症家庭的家人間扶持溫馨勵志小品鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天

programme.title: 整形過後--慾望與認同
programme.desc: 台灣首部整形醫療影集整形過後，整的不只是臉，而是心！！華麗卻殘酷的醫美產業，揭開變美的創傷與代價技術頂尖卻內心破碎的整形外科醫師江浩宇，遇上正直倔強從公立醫院轉來的楊雅頌，被迫直視醫療倫理與八年前未解的傷痛兩人與診所執行長蘇菲，交織出情感與權力的拉扯一樁樁醫美案例浮上檯面，被控制的女星術後猝死的公關非法醫療與重建自我的病人，不斷拷問真正的治療是什麼這是一段關於修復放下與重生的故事

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 全台首播心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.title: 只屬於我的你雙語版
programme.desc: 渣男律師劈腿富豪千金 李敏英逆襲成知名設計師恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 沒關係，是一家人完
programme.desc: 母親宣布卒婚引發家庭風暴 父親失憶揭露大女兒身世秘密故事圍繞著一對老年夫婦和他們的三名成年子女展開母親突然宣佈要卒婚，因厭倦與脾氣火爆的父親同居，父親則因委屈一度想輕生，卻失敗導致失憶回到22歲，意外揭露大女兒並非親生的秘密大女兒恩珠發現丈夫是同性戀，內心崩潰，而二女兒恩熙則陷入了複雜的感情糾葛中，被劈腿後又成了上司的情人小兒子智宇無意中知曉了家族的深藏秘密像外人一樣的家人間產生誤會，不斷磨合理解的家庭劇

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款! 尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛? 講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中夏娃的醜聞裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天邪門徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 落難千金嫁到三位惡婆婆家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪

programme.title: 抓住你的衣領
programme.desc: 改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款! 尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛? 講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中夏娃的醜聞裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天邪門徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 歐若拉公主

programme.title: 穹蒼下的世界英

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇英

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇英

programme.title: Abandoned
programme.desc: DNA detectives track down the British soldiers who fathered children in Kenya then disappeared, leaving the children and their mothers without support. Its?a quest to find a missing part of the childrens identities. With access to every stage of this?cutting-edge?process, we follow as a team of lawyers and a leading geneticist travel to Kenya to help?locate?the British soldiers who fathered children then vanished. We?witness?the groundbreaking legal and scientific detective work used to find the missing dads. Lawyers believe British soldiers stationed at the army base in Nanyuki, Kenya, may have fathered hundreds of children over decades - the oldest we meet is now 70, the youngest just 18 months old. Whats?at stake is more than the reputation of the British army and the UKs post-colonial legacy. The mixed-heritage children have in some cases been ostracised by their communities and denied a chance of British citizenship since birth - something which could transform their lives.

programme.desc: While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jacks Dad has got lost on route to collect him.

programme.title: Phones
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but its a little different than hes used to... hes going to need an app to order the food!

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

programme.title: The Mighty One
programme.desc: Lung seeks five volumes of a renowned Kung Fu manual to gain invincibility. When he believes a martial arts school master possesses the volumes, he kills him and his daughter but leaves behind a young brother and sister. Years later, Lung loses two volumes and starts another bloody hunt but each attempt is interrupted by two mysterious warriors...

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: Yin Tian Chous parents were killed over a pair of flame-shaped blades. He and his sister were rescued, raised, and trained separately by a hero and a villain, each inheriting one of the blades. Sworn enemies at first, they eventually uncover their true identities and join forces to avenge their parents deaths.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Huis husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hongs enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fans fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: Opium And The Kung-Fu Master
programme.desc: Tie Qiao San, head of the Ten Guangdong Tigers, is an honourable master with many disciples. As opium becomes popular among the nobles, Tie starts taking it and gradually harms his body. When an opium houses owner defeats Tie in a fight and he is only saved from being killed by his disciple, Tie vows to quit opium and get back on his feet.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wongs disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: A righteous swordsman, Bai Yi Pang, seeks revenge on an evil clan but is crippled after being beaten up by them. Years later, a young man encounters Bai who is hiding in a cave. Bai decides to teach this determined young man his Swift Sword skills so that he can help Bai take revenge on the evil clan.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Longs wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called The Venoms, and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms!

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun...

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keepers daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu Da Jiang, a naive young man, is betrayed and hunted by his sworn brothers after a gold robbery goes wrong. Surviving against the odds, he gains the favour of a gang leader and embarks on a path of revenge with bodyguard Jin Yan. As rival gangs clash and feelings emerge, a violent underworld showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chens past insult.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the sick people of Asia and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brothers death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Taos house became haunted. Years later, Master Taos descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Caos enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Beis concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: IDC agent Jon survives a mission where his entire team is betrayed by their superior, Sean, leaving him with a life-threatening injury. Travelling to Malaysia to find his long-lost brother, he is drawn into a kidnapping case, only to discover his brother is involved, and Sean is the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kongs Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Sent to Japan by his master, Chen Zhen rescues and falls in love with fellow student Hiroko Yamada, only to be drawn into the Black Dragon gangs conspiracy. As Chinese students disappear and Jing Wu Martial Arts School comes under attack, he joins Liang Shao Wen to destroy a secret lab, foil the conspiracy, and defend his nations honour.

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Confession of Pain
programme.desc: Inspector Lau plans the murder of his father-in-law and shifts the suspicion away. When his wife grows suspicious, she hires his close friend, private investigator Bong, to uncover the truth. As the plot unravels, Lau escalates his schemes to silence all threats, leading to a deadly showdown between former friends.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Gifted salesman Siu Buck travels to Turkey to uncover his roots, only to find himself entangled in his spy fathers dangerous legacy. Caught in an international conspiracy involving a lethal bioterror threat, he is thrust into a high-stakes chase. As danger closes in, Buck must push beyond his limits to stop a global crisis.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Rileys mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Mans best friend. Both are discovered by Danny Lee, a handsome young explorer who brings the odd couple back to Hong Kong, where Evelyne

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his familys massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting Alfred Chang who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: Catch that Drone The Fairy of the Teeth
programme.desc: When Harpers drone flies away its up to the Dew Drops to get it back. And while Eden wishes she could fly like a drone, she learns that she can do great things with or without wings. When Dylan loses his first tooth the Dew Drops learn that the Tooth Fairy will be coming and Athena tries so hard to make a good impression that she almost ruins Dylans first lost tooth experience.

programme.title: Lost and Found In the Park In the Dark
programme.desc: The Community Centers Lost and Found is full and its up to the gang to use their detective skills and return the lost items to their original owners. Rodney only needs one more bird on his birdwatching list, but the only problem is that it only comes out at night! Team Zenko must help Rodney face his fear of the dark so he can get the last picture for his collection.

programme.title: Longest Yardwork The Girl Who Cried Goose
programme.desc: Donna plans a garden party for Rona, but the only problem is that her garden is overgrown and neglected. The team try to transform this jungle into a backyard just in time for the party. Lula finds an angry goose on the loose, and Team Zenko need to get it out of the park before soccer camp starts.

programme.title: Bands On The Run Vote For Casper
programme.desc: Bands on the Run Casper and Jimmy form a rock band to compete in the Deedstown Battle of the Bands. Vote for Casper Mantha is angling to win the office of Class Rep, but Kibosh fancies having a fellow ghost in power.

programme.title: Permission ImpossibleWhat Possessed You
programme.desc: Permission Impossible When Ras parents refuse to let him go on the school camping trip, he sneaks away and gets lost in the Scary Woods with Casper and Mantha. What Possessed You? When a lesson in taking possession of a human body goes awry, Caspers human ends up taking possession of him!

programme.title: The Yarn Fairy Bake It Til You Make It
programme.desc: When the trees start losing their leaves, Phoebe begins knitting the trees in the park sweaters, but when the neighborhood kids see the sweaters they think theyre a mysterious Yarn Fairy, and they want to see her in action, making it much harder for the Dews to put more sweaters on the latest trees that have lost their leaves. When Marcus and Harper team-up for a school project, they decide to bake something Its like inventing, but with food!, only to come across multiple baking missha

programme.title: Things That Go Bump Hide Like a Dew Drop
programme.desc: When something starts snatching things and causing havoc in Marcus house, Phoebe and the Dew Drops investigate only to find that its a stray kitten that they need to catch and find a home for before Marcus returns home. But in the end, Marcus decides to take the kitty in, as his own. Lola isnt very good at Hide Seek so the Dew Drops help her improve her game. But she becomes so good that no one can find her! And now shes going to be late to her own surprise tea party!

programme.title: Message in a Bubble Glitteretti
programme.desc: Kelp has a new trick with his bubbles: he can have his friends put voice messages inside that you hear when you pop them. But when Pixie decides she doesnt want the others to hear whats in her bubble, the chase is on to rescue it! Juniper is devastated when the traditional ceremony to celebrate her next level of spark achievement cant happen. Kelp helps introduce a new tradition.

programme.title: Talent Show Sad Sad Plant
programme.desc: Kelp writes a song about him and Scallop to perform at the unicorn show. But when it comes time, Scallop wants to keep the song just for them, leaving Kelp to come up with anew act- and fast! The kids all visit the magical musical plant greenhouse on Unicorn Land. They each pick a plant to take care of, and for Kelp its a sad, almost dead plant that he falls in love with.

programme.title: Dog the Right Thing
programme.desc: In preparation for the big race to determine the next Race Cadets, Sam Whippet challenges the Not Yet Cadets to build their own cars. The catch? The car parts are scattered throughout Pawston. The Not Yet Cadets compete in the final race to see which team will join the Race Cadets.

programme.title: All Paws on Deck Bonestand and Deliver
programme.desc: Tag wants to do something special for her Mom and Paws anniversary, so she recreates the boat cruise where her parents first met. Tag discovers that nothing is planned for Pawstons 100th birthday, so she decides the town needs to rebuild the old Bonestand for a big Pawston concert.

programme.title: Heavy Metal
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders get stuck in a cave with their rival, Magnus, during a race to find a new source of an important mineral.

programme.title: Iced Out
programme.desc: Frustrated that shes not fitting in with the team, Aggro goes off on her own with Elbone on a mission to save a dragon egg trapped in ice.

programme.title: Fire Marshal Melman
programme.desc: On Junior Marshals Day at the fire station, Melman gets stuck in a firetruck on its way to a real emergency. With Alexs help, Melman must overcome his fear of heights to help save a stuck cat, and learn that even heroes get scared sometimes.

programme.title: Fancy Fifths
programme.desc: When Marty accidentally steals a pair of slippers from a department store, he plans an elaborate heist to return them and learns in the end that its easier to own up to your mistakes than to cover them up.

programme.title: Big Poppy Neighbor War
programme.desc: When a troll starts to ruin the fun of open mic night Poppy is forced to enter a compliment battle.Branch tries to drive Sky Toronto away when he moves next door.

programme.title: Remote Out of Control Critter Comfort
programme.desc: Biggie takes Branchs superpowered remote but must return it before Branch finds outWhen Poppy builds a new home for a group of cute critters she accidentally attracts their predators.

programme.title: One Last Job
programme.desc: The team plans a heist in order to obtain the enchanted pendant that can lead them to the storm wheels. Elsewhere, Klaus and Veruca shipwreck on a mysterious island that is actually home to the mages, and also the Tianshang weapon helmet.

programme.title: Doom and Groom
programme.desc: Po and the team have one last attempt to get the pendant, but they will have to disrupt Jayeshs wedding, and contend with his guards, to do so. At the mage island, Klaus and Veruca get hold of the Tianshang helmet.

programme.title: The Pinging
programme.desc: Mr. Ping is possessed by the ghost of Master Mastodon, the ancient master sworn to protect the Tianshang storm wheels. After a ghostly sewer chase, Mastodon agrees to help our team to stop Klaus and Veruca. He reveals that their next step is to go across the sea to Central America.

programme.title: Ga Ba Goo Ba Ga The Babblist
programme.desc: Theres a new babblist in town- someone who claims to understand baby talk. Boss Baby spots this fraud right awayand must debunk his tactics before he scams the playgroup parents. MeanwhileTim tries to sell magazines with Boss Babys help.

programme.title: The Coo Chi Coup
programme.desc: Boss Baby loves awards- and the Golden Rattle trophy is no exception. When presented with the chance to win an award at a company retreathe must choose between his pride and his team.

programme.title: Lights, Camera, Org Chart!
programme.desc: Boss Baby creates an org chart to cement his leadership as the Boss of the playgroup babies. However when Bubbeezee photographer Travis Le Duque chooses anyone but Boss for his coverspreadthe status quo is upended! Tim continues to fail his class assignment: a model solar system

programme.title: End of the Dragon Master
programme.desc: Po, the kids, and the new Panda Guardians must work together to defeat Jindiao once and for all, and get a visit from an unlikely source

programme.title: Journey to the East
programme.desc: Feeling a little bored with their new hero life, Po and the kids are excited to accept an important invitation to the Forbidden City. Meanwhile, theres a curious disturbance deep in Panda Village...

programme.title: Curse of the Monkey King
programme.desc: Po and the Kids take a shortcut to the boat bound for the Forbidden City, and are waylaid by a tricky monkey. Zhizhu informs Mayor Li of some distressing sounds coming from the Wellspring.

programme.title: Straycation Part II
programme.desc: While the parents are away, the kids are in charge of the tree house, but when the punch monkeys invade the house, the kids find themselves out of their element.

programme.title: Thunder Misters
programme.desc: Jealous of the Thunder Sisters, the men on the farm undergo a series of difficult initiation rituals to try and join the exclusive tribe of women.

programme.title: Eep Walking
programme.desc: Eep loves action and adventure - its in her blood. But when Eep starts adventuring in her sleep, she has to try to find the cause of her new sleep walking to avoid ending up in dangerous situations.

programme.title: Chinese Nian Year Pt. 1
programme.desc: Its Chinese New Year! With Yi and Jin tied up in their respective CNY festival performances, Peng and a semi-disguised Everest hit the festive streets, eating and enjoying everything in sight. Meanwhile, while paying respects to her late father at a temple, Yi panics when an accident breaks her magical violin strings. She hurries back to find her friends, only to spot Peng and Everest and watch them get snatched up by a menacing, mysterious creature!

programme.title: Chinese Nian Year Pt. 2
programme.desc: Yi realizes that Peng and Everest were taken by Nian, the legendary dragon-like creature associated with Chinese New Year and hes also taken their other creature friends! With Burnish and Duchess help, Yi and Jin travel outside of the city to find Nians cave. But a skirmish in the cave drives the conflict with Nian back to the city, wreacking havoc on the festival. The crew and creatures band together to try to stop Nian, but theyre no match. Will Yi be able to create magic and connect wit

programme.title: Liam The Hero
programme.desc: In order to get a ticket to a Manga convention she desperately wants, Birch agrees to write a series of Manga strips featuring Liam as a suave, cool and heroic character. When Birch finally gets a chance to sit down and talk to her hero, he turns out to be a jerk.

programme.title: True Colors
programme.desc: When Raffi joins Amelias rock band, Birch follows on his heels as the bands manager. Soon shes writing songs that pit her and Raffi against their podmates. Pod 4s true colors are revealed once Birch realizes shes gone too far.

programme.title: Love Lessons
programme.desc: Liams role as romance advisor to the boys of Cosmos High gets under Birchs skin. Offended that Liam thinks female behaviour is nothing more than a collection of symbols, Birch watches as Liam misinterprets Sandras signals and ends up with pie on his face.

programme.title: Miss President
programme.desc: Birch runs for school president because she wants to see changes to the Art program at Cosmos High. On a whim, Liam gets involved and soon his goofy antics are winning him favours. Before long, its an all-out game of one-upmanship between the two cousins

programme.title: Olivia Measures Up
programme.desc: After Olivia teases Ian for being too short for a ride, Father mentions that someday Ian may be the taller sibling. Olivia employs a variety of comical methods to stop Ian from growing. She eventually comes to terms with her own height with the help of a great pair of shoes!

programme.title: Olivia And The Old West
programme.desc: The class bullfrog is lose, and Mrs. Hogenmuller leaves Olivia in charge as she goes to track it down. Olivia imagines herself as the sheriff of a Wild West town, keeping order and defending against a stampede of giant bullfrogs. But can shedo it alone, or will she need a little help from Francine?

programme.title: Olivias Fashion Show
programme.desc: After attending a disappointing fashion show with Grandma, Olivia designs some fabulous clothes and is determined to put on her own show. Unfortunately, her models Ian, Francine and Julian prove to be more difficult to work with than shed anticipated. Its up to Olivia to think fast and make the fashion show work!

programme.title: Olivia Makes A Video
programme.desc: When Father takes an out-of-town business trip, Olivia doesnt want him to miss a thing. She decides to create a video diary, filming her family and classmates everyday life, which isnt quite as exciting as shed hoped. So Olivia adds her own touch to the final presentation: a big song and dance finish. Dad is thrilled.

programme.title: Tree Troubles Missing Pieces
programme.desc: When Marcus brings home the class tree sapling for the weekend, the Dew Drops see it starting to wilt and must cheer the sapling up, so Marcus can make sure to plant it for his class. When Athena accidentally breaks Lolas nature sculpture, the Dew Drops must go on a scavenger hunt to replace the missing pieces.

programme.title: Tanakas Moving Castle Zenko Dont Go
programme.desc: Mr. Tanaka is moving places all by himself, so Team Zenko step in to assist, and learn the importance of asking people for help. When Sams skateboard competition falls on the same day as her favourite creator Ken KaBlams comic book signing, TZG secretly prevents him leaving town before she gets the chance to meet him.

programme.title: Driven to Distraction To Bee or Not To Bee
programme.desc: When easily-distracted Luis is tasked with getting flowers for his grandmothers birthday party, TZG secretly keeps him on track. When Rodneys honey bees escape from their apiary artificial beehive, TZG secretly brings them back.

programme.title: Merry Scary Christmas Time Waits For No Ghost
programme.desc: Merry Scary Christmas Its Christmas and Casper wants to spend the holiday with his human pal, Jimmy. Time Waits for No Ghost When Casper discovers a clock that can stop time, everyone wants to use it for his or her own purpose.

programme.title: Ghostbust A Move My Fair Harpy
programme.desc: Ghostbust a Move When Jimmys dad decides to move the family away from Deedstown, Casper and his friends vow to stop Mr. Bradley from selling their house. My Fair Harpy The Winter Chill Dance is coming up and Ra is determined to be king.

programme.title: Chore Score Dew Drop Swap
programme.desc: On Harpers first allowance day, the pets accidentally knock Harpers Piggy Bank over and lose one of her quarters that she was reserving to buy Nicholas an ice cream cone. Now the Dew Drops must scramble to replace it! When the Dew Drops struggle to help their kids with tasks that are outside their usual fairy-bilities, they decide to swap kids for the day, but ultimately learn they re exactly where they need to be because they know their families so well!

programme.title: Full House Gift Express
programme.desc: Nicholas keeps stuffing oversized objects inside Edens fairy home. But it creates a BIG problem when Harpers family wants to visit grandma and the car keys are nowhere to be found! When Harper gets sick, Marcus builds a pulley between their apartments to send Harper treats. But when Qwak, the chipmunk, breaks the pulley, the Dews must step in to keep the treat train running.

programme.title: Salty and Sweet Cruz Blues
programme.desc: Chef J tells Ollie he cooks with love. Kelp and Ollie set out to make food with love for him. When various food combos fail, Ollie considers giving up, because it isnt good enough. Kelp goes to his Dad for answers, and two seemingly different ingredients form something magical. When Cruz is not his usual upbeat self, Kelp tries various ways to cheer him up before realizing the best way to be a good friend is to just sit with him, and let him feel what hes feeling.

programme.title: Pet Sitters Narwhalicorn Day
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop pet-sit Crabby, who acts out until they realize hes missing home. Kelp feels like he cant choose between a celebration on land or under the sea. So he attempts to do both... at the same time!

programme.title: How to Start a Dragon Academy
programme.desc: Hiccup is given the responsibility to integrate dragons into the village of Berk and must contend with his rowdy friends, unruly dragons and an upset village elder.

programme.title: Viking For Hire
programme.desc: Now that dragon-killing is no longer necessary, Hiccup tries to find a new job for Gobber the Blacksmith, but the task proves harder than expected.

programme.title: Animal House
programme.desc: As an approaching storm threatens Berk, Hiccup must work fast to make peace between the food-providing farm animals and the dragons.

programme.title: The Terrible Twos
programme.desc: When Hiccup adopts a baby dragon that appears orphaned, Toothless becomes jealous and the baby dragons bereaved mother threatens the village.

programme.title: In Dragons We Trust
programme.desc: After the dragons of Berk are blamed for an outbreak of crime, Hiccup is determined to find out whats really going on before the dragons are exiled.

programme.title: CupKate
programme.desc: Its Kates birthday and everyone in the habitat has something amazing planned- but Melmans worried that his homemadehoof-made gift wont measure up. While on a no-holds barred quest to get Kate her favorite cupcakes, Melman learns the gift doesnt matter, as long as it comes from the heart.

programme.title: The Poppy Horror Picture Show Dinkles Dinkles Little Star
programme.desc: After hearing a scary story Poppy tries to help Biggie get over his fearsHoping to enhance Mr. Dinkles selfconfidence Biggie enters him into a Bergen pet show.

programme.title: The Party Games Trolly Tales
programme.desc: Everyone gets excited because its time for the Trolls Annual funbased Party GamesPoppy and Branch try to convince the Troll kids that the library is fun.

programme.title: Mister Mastodon
programme.desc: Po and team arrive in Guatemala and meet farmers who are facing a mysterious threat-- named The Protector, wielding the Storm Wheels. Elsewhere, Colin the Stag Knight and Weimin team up to go after Po and discover Mr. Pings connection to the widely feared Pirate Queen.

programme.title: Hide The Lightning
programme.desc: Po and team go to the city of Tikal to get more information on the Protector, but its easier said than done, since nobody in the town actually knows the identity of the Protector. Blade becomes increasingly frustrated and Po attempts to help her.

programme.title: The Beast
programme.desc: Po and team play a game of Pok-ta-pok against a family of armadillos for the opportunity to talk one on one with Zuma, the leader. The game brings out a highly competitive and aggressive side to Blade, known as The Beast. Back in China, Colin and Weimin find the Pirate Queen and become part of her pirate crew.

programme.title: The Big Break
programme.desc: Boss thought that breaking his arm was painfulbut the true pain starts at pediatrician Dr. Kevins jokes. Boss enlists the playgroup babies to defang the doctor of his comedians disease. Tim obsesses about keeping his little brother safe.

programme.title: Alvin the Outcasts
programme.desc: Alvin and the outcast Vikings terrorize Berk, left defenseless without their dragons, and now only Hiccup can bring them back.

programme.title: How to Pick Your Dragon
programme.desc: Stoick wants to train his own dragon and enlists Hiccup to help him tame the most ferocious species yet.

programme.title: Portrait of Hiccup as a Buff Man
programme.desc: Believing his father is disappointed in him, Hiccup sets out on a dangerous treasure hunt.

programme.desc: After a visit from Trader Johan, the dragons fall mysteriously ill and Hiccup and his friends must save them.

programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesnt take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesnt give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cows nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clowns face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! Whats that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: 国家记忆Memory of China
programme.desc: 中国第一档国史节目，以为国家留史，为民族留记，为人物立传为宗旨，展现党史国史军史中的重大历史事件各领域重大工程建设揭秘重大决策背后的故事讲述各阶层各时代代表性人物，记录讲述党的奋斗史创业史中国特色社会主义探索史改革开放进程史

programme.title: 走遍中国Around China
programme.desc: 主要以中国的某一城市（或地域或主题）为选题范围，选取其最具的历史传承风土人情杰出人物自然风光和发展变化以连续一周每天30分钟播出的大容量，向世界全景式地展现新世纪的中国城市（或地域）形象

programme.title: 海峡两岸Across the Strait
programme.desc: 中央电视台唯一的涉台时事新闻评论栏目节目宗旨是跟踪海峡热点，反映两岸民意，节目分为两个版块：第一个是热点扫描，主要报道当日的近期台湾岛内的热点新闻；第二个是热点透视，当日或近期涉台热点深度报道及两岸专家对此事的评论，并对两岸各个层面的交流交往进行跟踪报道

programme.title: 型男大主厨Stylish Man

programme.title: 正义女神Themis
programme.desc: 言惠知因一宗少年案放弃晋升高院机会，转任少年法庭裁判官，也因此与丈夫离婚她坚持不枉不纵，在惩罚与救赎之间守护公义，赢得法院上下敬重立志成为最年轻高院法官的郑邵文因她的到来仕途受阻面对连串少年罪案，两人在理念碰撞中，携手帮助迷途少年重返正轨After a life-changing juvenile crime case, Zhi leaves a fast-track High Court career for the Juvenile Court, costing her marriage. As she and ambitious magistrate Wen tackle difficult youth cases, they balance justice, compassion and redemption.

programme.title: 夏日奇妙书My Marvellous Fable
programme.desc: 实习编辑冯天蓝加入出版社的第一份任务就是去催畅销作家王葡萄的稿件，而她交稿的条件就是让冯天蓝从北京开车送她回老家琼海！在回乡的旅程中，王葡萄开始说一些真假参杂的故事，冯天蓝在整理书稿中拼凑出了王葡萄的人生，而王葡萄也在创作中反思自我两个心中有伤的人展开了互相治愈的浪漫奇幻之旅

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 百味人生Bittersweet Destiny
programme.desc: 百味人生是一部以料理为引线，交织情感人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜亲情的苦背叛的辣梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. programme.title: 追分成功Define Your Own Success

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

programme.title: Rooted Season 1
programme.desc: The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall each year.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue Season 1
programme.desc: Watch as the Lilongwe Wildlife team try to release two serval cats into the wild. One escapes and returns injured. Will their release be successful? A new baby vervet arrives in critical condition, and a giant owl flies to freedom.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue Season 1
programme.desc: Join Amanda on a white knuckle bush-whacking adventure to rescue a waterbuck caught by a poachers snare. Meanwhile, the centers resident hyena is treated for flea bitten ears and Alma gets a mysterious late night monkey delivery.

programme.title: Jaguar Journals Season 1
programme.desc: Watch the Onafari team get to know Aroeira, their newly collared female, and take a peek at Auroras cub, Apolo. Continue to track Badalo, who has moved deeper into the flooded forest, where he puts Lizzies game-changing research in jeopardy.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

programme.title: Baby Animals Season 1
programme.desc: Not all infants in the animal kingdom get to have a good mother. But these are the stories of the lucky ones, from a ring-tailed lemur who learns everything from its mom to a tiny orangutan that receives a constant supply of motherly cuddles.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends Season 1
programme.desc: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a duck that wont go in the water without a ride from her pooch pal, an elephant that thinks shes a buffalo, and a herd of cows that adopt an orphaned deer.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Tasmanian Devil Season 1
programme.desc: For Tasmanian devils, dominance is the name of the game during mating season. Meet males who fight for the right to pass on their genes, and learn about the violent, noisy etiquette of these carnivorous marsupials mealtime.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Tasmanian Devil Season 1
programme.desc: Tasmanian Devils might have the most infamous reputations of any of the countrys marsupials, but these spirited scrappers also have another side. Theyre committed parents and heroic defenders of their pouch-reared young.

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk Season 1
programme.desc: Live through a sunny tropical September day with creatures from Polynesia to the Indonesian archipelago. See how the sun affects the movement, feeding habits, and mating rituals of everything from tiny zooplankton to whale sharks.

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk Season 1
programme.desc: Celebrate the first day of spring with Aussie creatures looking for either a dinner or a date. From the kangaroos in the grasslands to the koalas in the trees to the freshwater crocodiles, they hunt for food or fight for breeding rights.

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk Season 1
programme.desc: Meet the unique primates and reptiles searching for water and dodging predators, from ring-tailed lemurs in the east coast rainforests to tiny brown leaf chameleons, in this land of extreme climate variations and habitats.

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk Season 1
programme.desc: Visit one of the most arid and hottest parts of the world to discover how dhub lizards and dromedary camels adapted to withstand the intense conditions. Then move into the more moderate southern mountains, where rare hyrax and chameleons forage.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2
programme.desc: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continents animals on our own journey of evolution, yet intelligence took us on a very different path. Our curiosity led to questions about the world around us which were answered through stories, myths and legends.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2
programme.desc: Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk losing the tip to a poachers snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. But the snares indiscriminate nature means other animals often fall foul of them, with devastating results. Chilema is now having to adapt to life without an elephants most important appendage. She must learn how to eat, drink and also take a mud bath to ensure her survival. With the added challenge of the harsh dry season, Chilema is fighting against the odds to sur...

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2
programme.desc: Trees are Africas oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths most precious ecosystems.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1
programme.desc: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

programme.title: Evolution Earth Season 1
programme.desc: Trek to the planets quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map and prevent global warming.

programme.title: Evolution Earth Season 1
programme.desc: Explore one of Earths most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planet.

programme.title: Wild Science Season 1
programme.desc: Trace the lions rise from prehistoric predator to modern ruler as science reveals the battles, bonds, and brutal survival strategies that have shaped this iconic African hunter. Get swept up in the drama of lion society and high-risk hunts.

programme.title: Wild Science Season 1
programme.desc: Confront the oceans most versatile and formidable predator. Learn about the biological advantages that helped this prehistoric species survive multiple mass extinctions, then get awed by the relentless hunting skills of bull sharks.

programme.title: Planet Shark Season 1
programme.desc: Stalk the seas with sharks as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. Watch a whitetip reef shark put its electrical sensors to work finding its preys heartbeat, and the pelagic thresher shark stun its quarry with its whiplike tail.

programme.title: Planet Shark Season 1
programme.desc: Navigate the oceans vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness. Meet a lone blue shark traversing stormy Atlantic seas, and hundreds of hammerheads returning to their Pacific island breeding ground.

programme.title: Planet Shark Season 1
programme.desc: Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land.

programme.title: Pushpa: The Rise - Part 1
programme.desc: Pushpa: The Rise - Part 1 - A gripping tale of Pushpa Rajs daring rise in red sandalwood smuggling, defying odds and battling enemies to claim power. programme.title: Titi Kayu
programme.desc: Alim, seorang pemuda Cina Peranakan yang disenangi penduduk kampung atas sikap ringan tulang, mengorbankan masa dan tenaga demi membina titi kayu bersama seorang budak bernama Umar, meskipun tidak mendapat sokongan ketua kampung.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Iskandar menolak sekerasnya untuk tidak berkahwin dengan Aisyah namun dia juga tidak berdaya apabila Farid datang dan mengugutnya. Aisyah juga tidak terkata, Aisyah tidak tahu dirinya telah di fitnah oleh Mak Su Ainin dan Fasha. Melihat Mak Su Ainin yang berpura pengsan akibat malu, Aisyah terpaksa redha. Dia redha berkahwin dengan seorang lelaki yang angkuh dan sombong dari hari pertama mereka berjumpa. Aisyah bukan sahaja dipaksa berkahwin tanpa rela, dia juga dihalau keluar oleh orang kampung dan Mak Su Ainin. Buntu dengan keadaan itu, Aisyah terpaksa akur dengan apa yang sedang berlaku dan pergi meninggalkan segala kenangan yang indah bersama arwah ibu dan bapanya. Sementara dalam kebencian, Iskandar terpaksa membawa Aisyah pulang ke sebuah kondo mewah milik Iskandar. Tengku Maria menerima khabar Iskandar sudah kembali, dia meminta Iskandar berjumpa dengannya dalam kadar segera jika mahu kekayaan yang sedang di milikinya kekal. Aisyah, terus di herdik dan diberi amaran keras oleh Iskandar untuk tinggal di dalam kondo mewah itu dan membuat segala perkerjaan seperti orang gaji.

programme.title: Aku Pilih Pelangi

programme.title: Huru Hara

programme.title: Kopi Pahit
programme.desc: Pasangan pengantin baru, Gendis dan Joel, yang terpaksa dikuarantin di hotel selama tujuh hari selepas pulang berbulan madu. Hubungan mereka diuji apabila gangguan daripada bekas kekasih Joel mencetuskan rasa cemburu dan pertengkaran hebat akibat emosi Gendis yang sensitif.

programme.title: Saranjana Kota Ghaib
programme.desc: Apabila Sitha, penyanyi utama kumpulan terkenal hilang, kumpulan itu meneruskan pencarian, mengetahui bahawa Sitha berada di Saranjana, sebuah bandar ghaib, dan untuk membawanya kembali, mereka mesti mencari portal melalui pengembaraan peristiwa mistik.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: Black S1 EP2
programme.desc: Pegawai penguatkuasa undang-undang Bunian 444 atau juga dikenali sebagai Black sedang diburu kerana rakan setugasnya seorang penderhaka, 419, telah melarikan diri ke dunia manusia. Menyedari 419 telah menghuni tubuh manusia, Black memutuskan untuk memasuki tubuh Malik untuk bersaing dengannya. Pada mata manusia, Malik telah terselamat daripada kematian dengan menakjubkan sekali dan akibat kejadian itu dia telah hilang ingatan. Dalam pada itu, Sofia mula menyedari yang Malik merupakan buat hatinya semasa kecil dan dia diselubungi rasa bersalah kerana telah meletak Malik dalam situasi bahaya. Namun Malik sekarang ialah Black - biadab, mementingkan diri sendiri dan tekad dengan satu tujuan dalam misinya. Adakah dia akan ingat siapa Sofia sebenarnya? Black mendapati dirinya berdepan dengan pembunuhan yang mengerikan semasa dia cuba mengharungi dunia manusia. Keadaan menjadi lebih rumit apabila seorang lelaki yang penuh misteri muncul dan membayangi setiap gerak-gerinya.

programme.title: Black S1 EP3
programme.desc: Black mula seronok berada dalam badan manusianya. Namun menghuni tubuh badan manusia ialah jenayah Kelas A dalam dunia Bunian - Black menerima kata dua - dia mesti dapat mencari 419 atau menerima hukuman yang paling menggerunkan. Meskipun begitu, satu lagi kes pembunuhan yang mengerikan telah berlaku, sama seperti kejadian baru-baru ini. Nampaknya mangsa seperti ada kaitan dengan Aisya. Lelaki dengan wajah berparut muncul untuk menyeksanya ... siapa dia dan kenapa Aisya mengikut arahannya? Sofia dapat tahu yang mungkin ayahnya telah dibunuh dan ini membawanya kepada CEO Insurans Mahkota, Lokman Nazir, yang boleh mendapatkan fail lama ayahnya ... dan mungkin menjadi petunjuk kepada identiti pembunuh ayahnya.

programme.title: Unhuman
programme.desc: Semasa keluar berkhemah, San dan rakan-rakannya dari sekolah menengah merakam gambar meteor yang terhempas. Gambar itu mengandungi petunjuk kematian seorang saintis yang menjalankan kerja eksperimen dengan organ manusia dan kemungkinan kaitan dengan ahli sihir Kemboja.

programme.title: Highland Tower
programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. Apa yang mereka temui tidak sesuai untuk mereka yang lemah semangat.

programme.title: Gateway
programme.desc: Sekumpulan penjenayah terdesak mencari perlindungan di rumah yang kelihatan seperti rumah biasa - tetapi mendapati ia menempatkan sesuatu yang jauh lebih jahat, dan lebih dunia lain, daripada yang mereka sangkakan pada mulanya

programme.title: Spirit Whisker: The Revenant
programme.desc: Seorang anak sulung keluarga kaya yang telah meninggal dunia tiba-tiba hidup semula selepas seekor kucing hitam misteri melompat ke atas mayatnya, yang membawa kepada kelakuannya yang pelik dan ganas yang menyebabkan keluarga itu huru-hara dan menimbulkan rahsia gelap di kalangan mereka.

programme.title: Sunti Facebook
programme.desc: Seorang gadis kampung yang lemah lembut dan pemalu, tetapi berubah menjadi penggoda serta ganas kerana ingin membalas dendam selepas dirogol.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP12
programme.desc: Ramli dan isterinya Mariam ke rumah Wan Peah untuk mengambil emaknya. Farhan, Cikgu Siti dan 3 sahabat kemudiannya masuk ke rumah Wan Peah, Mereka ternampak gambar Tok Hashim bersama-sama Wan Peah semasa muda. Malangnya Mak Timah muncul dan mengarahkan Farhan balik ke rumah. Sebenarnya Tok Hashim mempunyai hubungan cinta dengan Wan Peah 30 tahun lalu. Perkahwinannya dengan Mak Timah kerana terpaksa.

programme.title: Ganjil
programme.desc: Nabila kehilangan rantai lehernya dalam mimpinya. Apabila Amry mencadangkan mereka mencari rantai di rumah Nabila, dia mendapati kebenaran yang tidak selesa.

programme.title: The Equalizer S1
programme.desc: McCall berusaha mencari seorang wanita yang diculik oleh seorang pembunuh bersiri, yang jenayah lampaunya tidak pernah dikesan kerana mangsanya berasal dari komuniti terpinggir. Selain itu, McCall menghadapi masalah apabila aktivitinya sebagai vigilante menarik perhatian Peguam Daerah Manhattan, Avery Grafton Jennifer Ferrin.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP2
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Aafiyah kecewa apabila abangnya tidak melayan panggilannya, tambahan pula dia ketakutan dan dalam keadaan trauma. Aafiyah mengalami trauma, dia terpaksa melarikan diri apabila dikejar lelaki misteri dan cuba membunuhnya. Nasib baik Abang Zack muncul dan menyelamatkannya. Aafiyah balik ke rumah setelah sihat. Aafiyah sukakan Zack tetapi bukan sebagi kekasih. Aafiyah sekali lagi menjadi trauma apabila kucing kesayangannya di bunuh. Ini semua angkara Zacky yang menggunakan Rafeeq bagi memuaskan hatinya.

programme.title: J Retribusi
programme.desc: Jay, bekas ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK, kini menjadi pengawal keselamatan kepada Nadi, anak Dato Hashim. Ketika Dato Hashim terperangkap dalam rancangan penjenayah, Jay, bersama Chang dan Amy, berjuang menyelamatkan Nadi dari menjadi tebusan. Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.

programme.title: Three Days To Kill
programme.desc: Seorang ejen perisikan antarabangsa yang berbahaya bertekad untuk meninggalkan kehidupannya yang penuh risiko demi membina hubungan yang lebih rapat dengan isteri dan anak perempuannya yang telah lama terpisah. Tetapi terlebih dahulu, dia perlu menyelesaikan satu misi terakhir - walaupun itu bermakna dia perlu menguruskan dua tugas paling sukar setakat ini: memburu pengganas paling kejam di dunia dan menjaga anak perempuannya yang remaja buat pertama kali dalam sepuluh tahun, sementara isterinya tiada di bandar.

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: Seorang sarjan Pasukan Operasi Khas Tentera Amerika Syarikat yang telah dibebaskan, James Harper, sanggup mempertaruhkan segalanya demi keluarganya apabila dia menyertai sebuah organisasi kontraktor swasta.
