programme.title: Interchange
programme.desc: Dihantui oleh penglihatan yang suram, jurugambar forensik Adam berundur dari dunia, tinggal di rumah dan mengambil gambar jirannya sehingga dia diseret ke dalam penyiasatan lain oleh kawan baiknya, Detektif Man, yang meminta bantuannya untuk menyelesaikan siri pembunuhan ritual yang mengerikan. Pada masa yang sama, hobi Adam yang kelihatan tidak berbahaya tidak lama kemudian menjadi lebih gelap apabila dia mengintip Iva, seorang wanita muda dari Borneo. Terpesona olehnya, dia tidak lama lagi terjerat dalam rangkaian misteri dan pembunuhannya. Ketika Adam diseret lebih jauh ke dalam dunia puak Iva dan Man menyelidiki penyiasatannya dengan lebih mendalam, mereka menemui mistik bawah tanah bomoh dan makhluk ghaib di bandar itu.

programme.desc: Mak Timah dan Cikgu Zaiton masih tidak berpuas hati dengan Cikgu Siti yang dikatakan memiliki ilmu hitam. programme.title: Gema Haflah
programme.desc: Susunan program hiburan islamik setiap minggu bersama sama dengan barisan artis dalam Dari Studio Hijrah, berselawat dalam Hijrah Berselawat dan bertaranun dalam Gema Haflah.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.desc: Jin Notti, seekor jin nakal dari dunia jin, dihantar ke bumi untuk belajar menjadi baik dengan membantu manusia. Namun, misinya jadi huru-hara apabila dia jatuh cinta dengan gadis manusia bernama Amy, lalu mencetuskan pelbagai situasi lucu dan romantik antara dua dunia.

programme.title: The Voice of Hind Rajab
programme.desc: Mengisahkan kejadian sebenar tentang Hind Rajab, seorang kanak-kanak perempuan berusia 6 tahun yang terperangkap di dalam sebuah kereta di Gaza dan membuat panggilan kecemasan untuk mendapatkan bantuan. Filem ini mengikuti usaha sukarelawan Bulan Sabit Merah Palestin yang cuba mengekalkan talian komunikasi dengannya sambil berusaha menghantar bantuan menyelamat. Sebuah kisah menyentuh hati tentang kemanusiaan, konflik dan harapan di tengah tragedi perang.

programme.title: Diari Abah
programme.desc: Rahmat dipulaukan oleh tiga anaknya, Annur, Zarif Zakuan, setelah berkahwin buat kali kedua dengan Ashikin, ibu tunggal anak satu. Anak-anaknya menganggap kematian ibu mereka, Khalijad berpunca daripada keputusan Rahmat berkahwin lain. Namun mereka semua tersedar apabila Ashikin telah menyerahkan sebuah diari kepada mereka bertiga setelah Rahmat meninggal dunia. Tercatat dalam diari itu bahawa segala duit yang dikirimkan setiap bulan digunakan abah mereka untuk mendirikan rumah anak yatim atas permintaan arwah ibu mereka dengan nama Rumah Anak Yatim Cik Khalijah.

programme.title: Me VS Mami
programme.desc: Mira terpaksa menemani ibunya, Maudy, dalam satu perjalanan jauh untuk menziarahi neneknya yang sedang tenat. Sepanjang perjalanan, hubungan mereka yang sering dipenuhi pertengkaran diuji melalui pelbagai cabaran dan pertemuan baharu, sehingga mereka akhirnya saling memahami dan mengeratkan hubungan sebagai ibu dan anak.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

programme.title: Kasih Seorang Ayah
programme.desc: Husin yang baru memulakan pekerjaan baharu dikejutkan oleh panggilan isterinya, Aminahayahnya, Pak Yusof, tidak pulang sejak keluar pagi tadi. Setelah mencari ke merata tempat, Husin akhirnya menemui Pak Yusof di sebuah perhentian bas dalam keadaan keliru dan ketakutan. Pak Yusof tidak ingat jalan pulang, malah tidak tahu di mana dia berada. Hairan dengan perubahan sikap ayahnya, Husin membawa beliau ke klinik. Di situlah mereka menerima berita yang mengejutkan: Pak Yusof menghidap Alzheimer. Dari saat itu, bermulalah perjalanan penuh cabaran buat Husin dan keluarganya dalam menjaga insan yang mereka sayangi.

Dalam usaha mencapai kejayaan, mereka berdepan pelbagai cabaran, pengorbanan dan konflik, namun terus menghiburkan penonton dengan jenaka dan semangat yang tidak pernah luntur.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong and Global View
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU SIT KA YIN, NANCY met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI KWOK FUNG and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO SHEH CHARMAINE and her adopted child, MAN CHOR CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN. Having been abandoned by her lover, CHORs mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING TONG MICHAEL. CHORs voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HOs future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HOs heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Her Railway Trip Whats On Today
programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname Tetsuko meaning railway girl. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5
programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: Grow Grow Grow With You
programme.desc: From Hopscotch to Hands Up, TVBs childrens programs have accompanied childrens growth, creating countless wonderful childhood memories. Veteran childrens program hosts Tam Yuk-ying, Lai Chi-shan, and Gai Sai-bo have also grown up alongside you! Each episode will feature a different theme, inviting hosts from different eras to reunite and reminisce about the past. Decades have passed, and the young hosts and participants of yesteryear have all grown up considerably. The hosts have gone out of their way to find these people and relive those memorable moments with everyone. The classic segment Soaring Through the Air holds countless happy memories. The hosts and guest Ali Lee will guide a new generation of children through the fun.

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing Sammy has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan Priscilla Wong, causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai KK Cheung, Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam. Gold digger Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan.

programme.desc: Many urban dwellers are constantly striving for a living and a career, leaving no time for relaxation. The accumulated stress can quickly trigger health problems. This program invites professionals from various fields, such as aromatherapists, music therapists, color therapists, nutritionists, and psychologists, to use accessible methods, including case studies and fun quizzes, to bring out the harmony and balance of the five senses, helping viewers instantly release stress. Celebrities will also be invited to have candid conversations with the host, sharing their effective methods for coping with the heavy pressures of life and work. The program also includes many interesting stress-reduction tips to deepen viewers understanding of the importance of stress reduction for health.

programme.title: Try It? Really? Sr.2
programme.desc: Midlife, Sing Shine! 4 has officially launched, continuing the success of the previous three seasons and once again providing a stage for singing enthusiasts to pursue their dreams. This season expands its recruitment efforts to North America and Australia, with several TVB artists participating masked, igniting the flame of music globally and illuminating the hearts of countless dreamers. Stephanie Che continues to host, offering her warm smile to the contestants Maria Cordero, Chow Kwok-fung, Cheung Ka-tim, Hai-er, and Gu Ya-wei also serve as judges, providing professional feedback and encouragement to the participants. On this new seasons stage, everyone will weave an even more moving chapter with music, continuing the heartfelt story of Midlife, Sing Shine! 4.

programme.title: A Date with Goddess Sr.2
programme.desc: The core premise revolves around TVBs eligible single female artists dubbed the Goddesses who participate in an unscripted journey to find real romance. Single male contestants from all walks of liferecruited through a worldwide open casting callcompete through speed dates, interactive challenges, and romantic one-on-one dates to win their hearts.

programme.title: Dear Leslie 70
programme.desc: Dear Leslie 70 is a TVB Jade memorial music special honoring the 70th birth anniversary of Hong Kong legend Leslie Cheung. The show celebrates his legacy across Cantopop, TV, and cinema by showcasing iconic archival performances, classic hits like Monica and Chase, and tribute covers by fellow artists. It also features personal stories and memories shared by close friends, including Leo Ku performing the tribute song Dear Leslie.

programme.title: Star Weekly
programme.desc: The talk show Star Weekly invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special Fact Check segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth!

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in Food News Report, highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5
programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.desc: Thailand expert Hu Huichong once again leads the Tom Yum Family members to introduce the latest travel information in Bangkok, including glamorous massage parlors with perfect photo spots, newly opened shopping malls with sky parks, and buffet restaurants hailed as the pinnacle of Bangkok tourism. The content is truly rich in Thai elements. In addition, Bobo Huang Jingling continues to appear in this episode, giving away plenty of perks. She will accompany Hu Huichong to visit Ayutthaya, Khao Yai, and other areas around Bangkok, recommending popular holiday destinations for locals. Besides unboxing hotels, they will also visit pseudo-Japanese photo spots and hotel-attached childrens playgrounds, guaranteeing an authentic Thai experience.

programme.title: Mystery Files
programme.desc: Love is an extremely complex subject, surrounded by numerous environmental factors that can alter our dreams and understanding of romance. These factorsranging from changes in age and the rise of internet culture to the emergence of scams and other seemingly unusual reasonshave led to bizarre, worldview-shattering love stories in society. The TVB Plus live show Mystery Files hosted by Fire Lee, Jinny Ng, and Randal Tsang, invites people from all walks of life, celebrity guests, and relationship experts to discuss each episodes theme. With unique perspectives and thought-provoking questions, they boldly explore emotional dilemmas, while also welcoming viewers to join the conversation and solve problems together through the live chatroom and call-ins.

programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again
programme.desc: You Are Not Alone triumphantly returns! In its second season, the show is once again led by the King of Ghosts Leung Si Ho, together with co-hosts Wong Yiu Ying and Wong Chi Yan, as well as editors Wong Ying Yeuk and Tong Chi Yan, bringing audiences even more frights and surprises. Each episode focuses on a different supernatural theme, featuring heavyweight guests who share ghost stories and reveal the secrets of rituals and industry customs. With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. Real-time interaction with the audience is also a highlight of Spirit Connection, with the team closely following live broadcasts,

programme.title: Memory of China
programme.desc: Memory of China is the first history program of China, the TV program unveils secrets of important historical events, mega projects and the untold stories behind those crucial decisions of this country.

programme.title: Across the Strait
programme.desc: The Across the Strait traces the much-discussed issues across the Strait, reflects the will of the citizens on two sides of the Strait and details the Chinese Governments policy of one country, two systems in a bid to enhance the Taiwan fellowmens understanding of the Mainland China.

programme.title: China News
programme.desc: It concentrates on the latest news and social changes happening in china and all over the world

programme.title: Focus Today
programme.desc: Traces the current affairs from china and the world

programme.title: Talk with LuJian
programme.desc: Talk with LuJian

programme.title: Network News
programme.desc: Network News is a 30min news, news about china and the world.

programme.title: Yi Yi Xiang Bei Feng
programme.desc: Following a group of educated youth in Liangchuan Cityincluding Sheng Xuezhu and Yu Leshanthis drama spans 15 years of emotional entanglements and business ups and downs. The series highlights individual choices regarding family, friendship, and love against the backdrop of a changing era.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show. Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: New Taiwan Is Online
programme.desc: In a media landscape flooded with misinformation, this current affairs programme cuts through the noise with sharp analysis and investigative reporting. Hosted by Lee Cheng Hao, the show uncovers hidden issues and speaks up for the people, delivering clarity and accountability in every episode.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan presents a series of tales and folktales in Taiwan that have been pass down from one generation to another generation.

programme.title: Taste of Life
programme.desc: Chu-Tsai Chao and his wife have five children. Having devoted his entire life to developing soy sauce products, Chu-Tsai sincerely hopes that one of his children will follow in his footsteps and take over the family business. However, he also respects their individual passions and aspirations. Because of their fathers dream of innovation, the lives of the Chao brothers are about to change.

programme.title: Venus Online
programme.desc: Venus Online is a vibrant lifestyle and beauty show featuring the latest in makeup, skincare, and fashion. Each episode shares practical tips and fun challenges that inspire confidence and celebrate personal style.

programme.title: Girls Tease
programme.desc: This show focuses on the issues that are most important to urban modern women. It combines current events with discussions of lifes major and minor problems and invites various specialists to address various difficulties. Netizens will occasionally attend the show to share their own stories and ask questions of the guests and experts, making the topics more relevant and audience-focused!

programme.title: Top Singers
programme.desc: The show Top Singers aims to spotlight outstanding Taiwanese singers and composers, setting a new standard in the industry. Combining elements of competition, variety, and personal stories, the show welcomes participants of all ages. Its goals include discovering grassroots talent, innovating Taiwanese song performance styles, and involving more local talent in song composition to infuse new life into Taiwanese music.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Every second counts in Show Biz to bring you with the most High Speed star news, exciting live shows and performers interviews.

programme.title: Love, Now
programme.desc: Lan Shi De, who lost his first love in college, reunites with Yang Yi Ru in a foreign land. When he learns she has only six months to live, he decides to marry her and fulfill her dream wedding. Eight days later, she mysteriously disappears, and Shi De vows not to let true love slip away again.

programme.title: Stuntman
programme.desc: Washed-up stunt director Li Sen is offered the role of action choreographer on his director friends final film. Bringing along an ambitious young stuntman, the two generations risk everything to stage a comeback. As Li Sen battles his fierce temper and past mistakes, he also strives to mend his relationship with his estranged daughter.

programme.title: Demi-Haunted
programme.desc: Wan Fei is a promising Chinese Opera singer who is secretly in love with a man named Jiang Hao Feng. She wants to sing for him on stage but dies mid-song in a tragic accident. Years later, Wan Feis ghost returns, and finds that part of her spirit has been reincarnated in the form of Chor Bai, a young Chinese Opera singer. This finally allows Wan Fei to fulfill her wish

programme.title: Love Lies
programme.desc: Gynaecologist Veronica downloads a dating app for fun. Little does she know that the charming French engineer on the other end is actually a local con artist named Joe, who is a member of an online scam group. As their fake relationship unfolds, both Joes guilty conscience and Veronicas hopes intensify.

programme.title: The White Storm 3 Heaven Or Hell
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Billy works undercover in Suchats drug cartel, while another undercover cop Wing successfully earns their trust in an incident and a brotherly bond is built among the three. When the police busts the syndicate, Suchat flees to the Golden Triangle with Billy and receives a tip-off about the betrayal within his circle of trust

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well 2009
programme.desc: Successful businesswoman Yu Chu has no chance of finding a husband with her insufferable personality, much to the consternation of her younger brother Yu Bo, who due to a curse, will fail in love until his sister gets married. Yu Bo hires a love expert, Dick, to woo his sister. Smitten at first sight, Yu Chu is not about to let Dick get away...

programme.title: A Legend
programme.desc: Archaeologist Professor Fang uncovers artifacts from a glacier expedition that resembles a jade pendant in his dream. To unveil the truth, Professor Fang leads his team to a journey into the glacier, embarking on a fantastical adventure together.

programme.title: Welcome to My Side
programme.desc: After a painful breakup and a strange accident, Chen Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks that only he can see. His bizarre curse disappears whenever he is with the cheerful Feng Jia Nan. As they grow closer, an absurd yet heartwarming romance blossoms, changing both their lives in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Pavane For An Infant
programme.desc: In a conservative society, a baby hatch that never closes sparks fierce moral controversy and public backlash. Despite mounting criticism and pressure, Lai Sum, Fatimah, Kam Jie and Nuru remain steadfast in their mission to protect desperate mothers with nowhere else to turn, while offering abandoned newborns a fragile chance at life and hope.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: Mr Mrs Incredible
programme.desc: Middle-aged and retired superhero couple, Huan Gazer Man and Red Aroma Woman, settles into a contented life in a remote village. They find it hard to contain their powers though, and are bored by the uneventful life. When they hear a world martial arts contest is to be held in their village, both are itching to make their long-awaited comeback!

programme.title: Ready OR Knot
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi have been together for five years since they first met in a wedding banquet, but marriage soon becomes a challenge to their relationship. Heidi sees marriage as a testimony of their love, while Guy sees it as doomsday. Can the couple resolve their conflict? Are they ready or not?

programme.title: Dragon Tiger Gate
programme.desc: Adapted from a famous Hong Kong comic, Tiger Wong is ambushed after he unwittingly took the Lousha Plaque but is saved by his brother Dragon Wong. They also befriended Turbo Shek during the fight and the trio forms a brotherhood. To avenge the death of the Dragon Gate masters, they train and vow to defeat Shibumi, the leader of Lousha Clan.

programme.title: Once in a Blue Moon
programme.desc: Mei Zhens family appears to get along but harbours deep secrets. Mei Zhen is trapped in a dead-end job with a toxic boss, her brother hides his separation and their mother grapples with lingering guilt over her husbands departure years ago. As Mid-Autumn Festival approaches, can the family heal their wounds and find a way back to each other?

programme.title: 72 Tenants of Prosperity
programme.desc: Ha Kung and Shek Kin are sworn brothers, but become sworn enemies in business and every aspect of life after Pinky, the girl they love, marries Ha Kung. It is only when the property owner of both their shops wants to terminate their tenancies forty years later, that they are able to resolve the rivalry.

programme.title: Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: A school bus accident kills almost everyone on board. The bus driver got injured and partially lost his memory while rescuing one of the boys. To thank the driver, the boys dad, Wang, brings him to live with the family in their basement. However, the driver soon discovers strange behaviours from the Wangs which seem to be related to the accident.

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A Chinese dessert shop owned by the Chang family in Kowloon City faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. Their daughter sacrifices her dream of becoming a flight attendant to help keep the family business alive, but tensions rise as she clashes with her father. Can they find a way to overcome their struggles and remain united?

programme.title: Behind the Shadows
programme.desc: Private detective Ouyang uncovers his wifes betrayal during an investigation. Reeling from the shock, he abandons a missing person case. Soon after, the missing person turns up dead. Inspector Chen suspects a serial killer may be at large. Now drawn back into the case, Ouyang must use his skills to stop the killer before another life is taken.

programme.title: Victims
programme.desc: A ruthless Kuala Lumpur high school student kills his classmate, exposing the contrasting struggles of the victims mother and the murderers mother as they uncover their sons hidden secrets, while inching closer to a heartbreaking truth.

programme.title: Wild City
programme.desc: A cop-turned-bar-owner befriends a drunken woman at closing hours and finds himself pursued by her former lover and the thugs he employs. The chase turns deadly when the bar owners deadbeat brother and a suitcase full of cash enter the picture.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Amid the recession caused by the pandemic, debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. His unconventional approach leads to unexpected success, and his attitude toward his career and life is transformed after being inspired by the respected Master Wen.

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit
programme.desc: Three devastated parents, pushed to the edge by the abduction of their children, forge a fierce alliance in the barren deserts. Driven by fury and grief, they embark on a lawless, violent crusade to hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate. Can they shatter the criminal ring and bring their children home alive?

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

programme.title: The Mighty One
programme.desc: Lung seeks five volumes of a renowned Kung Fu manual to gain invincibility. When he believes a martial arts school master possesses the volumes, he kills him and his daughter but leaves behind a young brother and sister. Years later, Lung loses two volumes and starts another bloody hunt but each attempt is interrupted by two mysterious warriors...

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: Yin Tian Chous parents were killed over a pair of flame-shaped blades. He and his sister were rescued, raised, and trained separately by a hero and a villain, each inheriting one of the blades. Sworn enemies at first, they eventually uncover their true identities and join forces to avenge their parents deaths.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Huis husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hongs enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fans fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: Opium And The Kung-Fu Master
programme.desc: Tie Qiao San, head of the Ten Guangdong Tigers, is an honourable master with many disciples. As opium becomes popular among the nobles, Tie starts taking it and gradually harms his body. When an opium houses owner defeats Tie in a fight and he is only saved from being killed by his disciple, Tie vows to quit opium and get back on his feet.

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wongs disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: A righteous swordsman, Bai Yi Pang, seeks revenge on an evil clan but is crippled after being beaten up by them. Years later, a young man encounters Bai who is hiding in a cave. Bai decides to teach this determined young man his Swift Sword skills so that he can help Bai take revenge on the evil clan.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Longs wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called The Venoms, and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms!

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keepers daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu Da Jiang, a naive young man, is betrayed and hunted by his sworn brothers after a gold robbery goes wrong. Surviving against the odds, he gains the favour of a gang leader and embarks on a path of revenge with bodyguard Jin Yan. As rival gangs clash and feelings emerge, a violent underworld showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chens past insult.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the sick people of Asia and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brothers death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: Kavan
programme.desc: A TV journalist goes against the orders of his corrupt and dishonest boss and helps a group of youngsters in their fight against a pesticide factory.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Devaki has a stepdaughter Arya. She is a caring mother. One unfortunate night Arya is brutally attacked. When the justice system fails them, she goes to great lengths to find justice for her daughter.

programme.title: Officer On Duty
programme.desc: A demoted inspector investigates a counterfeit jewelry ring and becomes stuck in a deadly crime web that endangers his life and testshiscourage.

programme.title: Family Padam
programme.desc: A middle-class family who can afford movie tickets dreams of making a film to fulfill their younger sons wish to rediscover himself, facing grave challenges.

programme.title: Stalin
programme.desc: Stalin is deeply moved by the suicide of a girl with physical disabilities. As a result, he devises a formula of extending unconditional help to those who need it to establish peace.

programme.title: Thumbaa
programme.desc: Hari and Umapathy, two painters, meet Varsha, a wildlife photographer, while working in a forest. Soon, they team up to stop a corrupt officer from capturing a tiger, Thumbaa.

programme.title: Cold Case
programme.desc: When a skull is found in a package, ACP Sathyajith is assigned to identify the victim and catch the killer. Meanwhile, a journalist haunted by a spirit investigates the mystery.

programme.title: Bhagavanth Kesari
programme.desc: Bhagavanth Kesari encourages his late friends daughter to join the army while confronting a powerful man from his past who stands in their way.

programme.title: Madha Yaanai Koottam
programme.desc: Prithivi kill his uncles son unfortunately. So his uncle and other family members take revenge on him.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Akhanda
programme.desc: Akhanda, a devotee of Lord Shiva, protects Murali Krishna from Varadarajulus evil scheme. The story unfolds with divine intervention, bringing justice in a captivating tale of righteousness.

programme.title: Vaayai Moodi Pesavum
programme.desc: The people of the Panimalai hill station are in trouble as the government has put a ban on speaking to control the spread of the dumb-flu that spreads only through talking.

programme.title: V
programme.desc: When aliens land on Earth claiming to help humanity, they seem friendly at first. But as they integrate into society, their hidden agenda starts to unfold.

programme.title: Maamanithan
programme.desc: A humble auto driver, desperate to improve the standard of education for his children, convinces a real estate agent that he will help him sell all his plots.

She must learn how to eat, drink and also take a mud bath to ensure her survival. With the added challenge of the harsh dry season, Chilema is fighting against the odds to survive.

programme.title: Tales From Zambia

programme.title: 生活智多星第1830集
programme.desc: 人間衛視生活智多星邀請到好門媳婦－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上智多星本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解生活智多星內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射充滿元氣的不老傳說以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，生活智多星全面關心

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流人間新聞此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任人間新聞報導的焦點包含慈善公益社會關懷文化藝術人文教育心靈提升健康醫療環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌

programme.title: 青春進化論第97集

programme.title: 人生調色盤
programme.desc: 歌仔戲小生陳亞蘭小姐首次獨挑大梁，主持深度人物訪談節目人生調色盤 人生問題是一門大學問，悲歡離合生老病死是每個人會經歷的過程，特別是隨著社會發展而衍生出新的問題，例如職場與網路的霸凌憂鬱症親人失智長照等，都是過去所罕見的 節目透過嘉賓的經驗分享，輔以專家學者從旁論述分析，掌握選擇的思考過程，釐清正確的觀念，藉以產生改變自己的能量主持人陳亞蘭也發揮歌仔戲隱惡揚善的精神，將忠孝節義的處世準則，於節目中傳播出去 為了推廣台語之美，特別規劃亞蘭話俗語單元，每集介紹一句台灣俚俗語，簡單直白卻字字珠璣，不僅學習到老祖宗的智慧，也貼近自己的人生

programme.title: 人間新聞

programme.title: 人生調色盤
programme.desc: 歌仔戲小生陳亞蘭小姐首次獨挑大梁，主持深度人物訪談節目人生調色盤 人生問題是一門大學問，悲歡離合生老病死是每個人會經歷的過程，特別是隨著社會發展而衍生出新的問題，例如職場與網路的霸凌憂鬱症親人失智長照等，都是過去所罕見的 節目透過嘉賓的經驗分享，輔以專家學者從旁論述分析，掌握選擇的思考過程，釐清正確的觀念，藉以產生改變自己的能量主持人陳亞蘭也發揮歌仔戲隱惡揚善的精神，將忠孝節義的處世準則，於節目中傳播出去 為了推廣台語之美，特別規劃亞蘭話俗語單元，每集介紹一句台灣俚俗語，簡單直白卻字字珠璣，不僅學習到老祖宗的智慧，也貼近自己的人生

programme.title: 一樣的月光第12集
programme.desc: 一樣的月光是1983年蘇芮首張個人專輯的主打歌，也是1983年台灣電影搭錯車的插曲1983年，新藝城的導演虞戡平策畫一部結合音樂與戲劇的電影搭錯車；這部電影描繪了7080年代台灣經濟高速成長，阿美一心想進入的歌舞影壇的故事此張專輯成功將電影主角的故事與音樂結合，是台灣首度以音樂影片（MV）的方式製作專輯當時虞戡平仍在尋找主角的幕後主唱，在電視上聽到蘇芮演唱西洋歌曲，音色相當不錯，便屬意她來擔任主唱專輯由李壽全製作，並找來羅大佑梁弘志等人寫曲一樣的月光歌詞承襲了羅大佑的風格，對社會現象的改變做出批判與反省，蘇芮獨特的嗓音也造就了黑色蘇芮的旋風是中文流行音樂史上

programme.title: 我們的島第1374集
programme.desc: 一個一小時的節目，能帶給觀眾什麼，能影響什麼？如果把它只當成一個節目，會感覺短短一小時很短暫，如果把它當成一條出路，會發現力量也可以很強大，一直以來，我們節目的理念就是尋求一種改變的可能性，只要有一個人因為看過報導而改變了，反省也好，感動也好，警惕也好，行動也好，就有可能形塑一種新的環境公民力量，也有可能讓錯誤的政策不再繼續1998年11月1日我們的島節目正式播出，當年台灣的環境還處於大肆開發的年代，在經濟掛帥的氛圍中，我們的島為環境發出另一種聲音，至今我們的島仍是台灣媒體中，唯一以環境為報導主題的新聞性節目，也是公共電視開播以來歷史最久的新聞性節目，這十五年我們的島製作

programme.title: 大自然生趣第14集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道南路鷹一萬死九千這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，大自然生趣 大自然生趣，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味很湊巧的，生趣這兩個字，其實這是客語有趣的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是大自然真有趣這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.desc: 本集主持人前往義大利中部探索失落數千年的伊特魯里亞文明他們是早於羅馬的先進古文明，其下水道系統道路格鬥比賽甚至服飾等元素，都被日後征服他們的羅馬融入自己的帝國之中，成為羅馬引以為傲的文明標誌

programme.title: 層層透視古文明第5季:第17集
programme.desc: 本集節目帶領觀眾認識傳奇色彩濃厚的廷塔哲城堡這裡是傳說中亞瑟王的誕生地，更是固若金湯的要塞亞瑟王的傳說深植人心，也多次被改編為文學與影視作品，但這位傳奇君王有可能真實存在嗎？廷塔哲遺跡與附近地區的其他遺構能透露什麼線索呢？斯塔福德郡出土了豐富的大批遺物，均為武器相關物品，每一件都做工精良，各具特色，看得出物主地位崇高，物主有沒有可能就是亞瑟王？敬請鎖定本節目

programme.title: 金礦的賭注遠征篇第7季:第4集
programme.desc: 派克一行人來到巴西塞拉佩拉達，想解開克羅索坑道之謎

programme.title: 金礦的賭注遠征篇第7季:第5集
programme.desc: 派克來到巴西，在尋找塞拉佩拉達黃金的過程中有了新線索

programme.title: 絕地伐木勇士第2季:第14集
programme.desc: 自古以來，伐木一直是人類生活的重要產業，時至今日，仍是世界上最危險的工作之一樹越大，風險越高...報酬也越可觀在太平洋西北地區，伐木工傑瑞德道格拉斯帶著團隊，採伐世界上最巨大最有價值的樹種之一：北美檜木但要把這些體積跟巴士一樣大的巨木，從森林運送到市場一點也不容易不僅需要高超的鋸木功夫規模龐大的機械設備，還要有在地表最嚴酷環境上工的勇氣

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第13季:第11集
programme.desc: 本集節目中，介紹了食用蝸牛叉子和小輕艇的製作野外捕獲的蝸牛，要送入加工廠，經清洗去殼去腸煮熟和冷凍後，便能裝箱送出叉子的原料不鏽鋼，是將鉻鐵與鋼經處理後結合的成品；原料送至加工廠後，由模具壓出叉齒，再扳成彎曲的形狀，拋光後便完成本集介紹的小輕艇是專為釣魚而設計，具備特殊的動力鰭板，模仿水中動物的動作，裝在聚乙烯打造的船身中央，可自行在水中前進而不需划動

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第13季:第12集
programme.desc: 本集首先介紹能在戰區迅速搭建的乾式支援橋這種組合式的橋梁必須輕量又堅固，易於運輸，又能支撐坦克等重型車輛接著是油性麥克筆及螢光筆，除了看筆的各部位如何組成完整的筆，也看神奇發光墨水的製作過程最後是電動超級摩托車，透過簡化及輕量化，製造出世界上速度最快的機車

programme.title: 日用品傳奇第1季:第11集
programme.desc: 傳承與創新擦出火花，眾所周知的日用品從何而來？象徵美國西部的牛仔帽在百餘年後依舊堅持使用傳統技法做出一頂頂牛仔帽，維持品質與創新一塊加上輪子的板子成為街頭運動，創造歷史傳奇滑板手東尼霍克使用的滑板又有什麼特點讓他創造佳績？威化餅那懷舊的滋味到底是如何製成？至今仍備受喜愛的祕訣又是什麼？日用品歷久不衰的秘密在本集一一揭曉

programme.title: 日用品傳奇第1季:第12集
programme.desc: 一個突如其來的靈感改寫烤肉架的歷史，讓看似平凡的烤肉架成為家家戶戶的必備品隨手可得的護唇膏從何而來？跟著節目回溯到一切的源頭，探究一支小小的護唇膏如何改變生活，背後的秘密配方究竟是什麼？人人都需要乾淨的衣服，但人類如何從河邊洗衣演變成機器代勞？一起來認識流傳百年的日用品，揭開知名品牌背後的神秘面紗

programme.title: 亂屋整理術第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 本集的兩組委託人都被雜亂無章的地下室嚴重影響生活克里斯和克莉絲汀的地下室雜物堆積如山，夏蒙和塔瑪拉則搬進奶奶留下來的房屋，充滿回憶的同時，卻也飽受雜物堆積所苦

programme.title: 野地造屋-水上城堡

programme.title: 艾德史塔福-男子漢的洗禮第1季:第3集

programme.title: 裝修首購屋第1季:第2集

programme.title: 問題皮膚救星第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 本集患者瑞秋患有多發性神經纖維瘤，因此全身上下都是小肉疣，艾瑪醫師說服她改接受局部麻醉，並以二氧化碳雷射幫她切除這些纖維瘤，盡量撫平肌膚初次治療的成果讓瑞秋很滿意，手術的疼痛也在她的忍受範圍，之後她就能經常門診，透過小手術改善她的生活品質保羅則是背上長了範圍較寬的脂肪瘤，讓他有點沒自信，之後也在門診手術順利取出約翰是個臨時演員，但因為近年鼻子開始莫名越長越大，由於特徵過於特殊，阻礙了他的演藝之路，在艾瑪醫師的協助下，幫他的鼻子恢復往日面貌，找回自信心，重新踏上演藝之路珍妮特的左手腕則長了一個腱鞘囊腫，但由於位置很靠近動脈且還有周邊神經，最後艾瑪醫生轉診，請手外科醫師芭芭拉傑米克為珍妮特

programme.title: 聖地牙哥動物園第2季:第9集
programme.desc: 在本集節目中，加拉巴哥象龜艾比蓋爾的右後腳受了輕傷，走起路來一拐一拐，獸醫和保育員打算為牠做全身電腦斷層掃描棕熊史考特和蒙大拿食慾大開，為冬天做好準備兩隻害羞的母毛冠鹿即將迎接新的公鹿加入，可望生下鹿寶寶命運多舛的無尾熊歐米奧終於迎來週歲，保育員特地為牠佈置驚喜

programme.title: 野地寒冬第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 地球上最寒冷地區的冬天，挑戰動物的體能和認知能力的極限，動物們必須利用體型力量和靈敏度通過考驗

programme.title: 野性無窮盡第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 節目探究為何有些物種能存活千百年，而另一些生命卻在短短數日內走向終結從決定壽命界限的遺傳機制，到影響生存條件的環境因素，我們將探索塑造生命長度的複雜平衡，畢竟在野外世界中，長壽是一場罕見的勝利野性無窮盡將人類自身的生命旅程，與地球上最長壽及最短命的生命體巧妙對照，引發對生命的思考

programme.title: 自然怪事求解答第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 你有想過為什麼浣熊會爬25層的高樓大廈嗎？為什麼一隻鴨媽媽會帶著76隻鴨寶寶？還有黑頭鵐為什麼要去餵金魚？

programme.title: 自然怪事求解答第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 在猶他州大盆地沙漠，田野生物學家放了小牛屍體探索食腐動物行為，兩週後卻發現屍體人間蒸發

programme.title: 管教惡貓第4季:第5集
programme.desc: 蕾恩與德瑞克分別養了貓麗塔與巴迪，他們同居五個月，但貓咪卻相處不來，巴迪會霸凌麗塔，而德瑞克似乎洋洋得意傑克森第一次來看過後，針對狀況開出作業，但在他下次登門拜訪時，蕾恩與德瑞克竟然已經分手傑克森依舊到個別兩家幫助他們完成應該做的事情，兩隻貓也恢復平靜珍的貓帕妃在家裡到處亂尿，家裡臭氣沖天，她與室友妮可嘗試了很多辦法卻一點作用也沒有，傑克森上門了解後，發現是外面走動的小動物造成牠的不安全感，為了宣示地盤才做出這件事，找到癥結後，問題也迎刃而解

programme.title: 鱷魚拍檔這一家第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 明年是澳洲動物園50周年，為了慶祝這個里程碑，也為了紀念史帝夫，園方決定改造鱷魚展示區，因此必須將鱷魚暫時遷移率先遷移的是正值黃金年華園中最凶猛巨大的河口鱷波斯可，這次將由羅伯特負責跳壓頭部，對他來說意義非凡今年夏天氣溫屢創新高，無尾熊的繁殖數量遠低於以往隨著繁殖期進入尾聲，心急的無尾熊主任飼育員賦予公無尾熊哈雷繁殖的重責大任，大家的堅持總算沒有白費，哈雷成功讓年輕的母無尾熊瑪卡蝶迷雅第一次當媽媽公長頸鹿阿森一向是澳洲動物園長頸鹿繁殖計畫的主力，但是最近牠的左膝蓋腫脹疼痛獸醫與飼育員合作替阿森的膝蓋照X光，確定阿森得了關節炎，適當的治療將使阿森恢復健康正常的生活

programme.title: 野生王朝第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 在非洲最荒涼的地方，動物各有一套獨特技巧及防衛措施，除了活下去，還要確保後代能長大到成年，這就是非洲平原上的動物要面對的宿命大象斑馬牛羚等草食動物無法避開掠食者，只能隨時保持警戒，肉食動物為了餵飽自己的寶寶也各出奇招，豺犬打團體戰；鬣狗除了吃腐肉，還靠耐力對獵物緊追不捨；獵豹靠速度捕捉獵物；而胡狼則見機行事，偷走別人的獵物，牠們都全力以赴，在充滿變數的非洲大地上尋找生機

programme.title: 自然怪事求解答第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 科學家認為鳥蛋的形狀越尖，這種鳥的飛行能力就越強，在空中飛行時間越久但凡事必有例外

programme.desc: 法蘭克走訪加州著名的崎嶇海岸，這個地帶是海洋保護區，經常能看到許多海洋生物

programme.title: 動物軍火庫第2集
programme.desc: 動物互毆博鬥的本領，在自然界的戰場，可能造成生與死的區別，野牛兜蟲蝦蛄鴕鳥銀背大猩猩都是高手

programme.title: 狗狗101新把戲第1季:第11集
programme.desc: 本集介紹一些最被人誤解的犬種，以及牠們真正的性情，包括英國比特鬥牛犬洛威拿犬德國牧羊犬杜賓犬秋田鬆獅犬和英國獒犬這幾種狗因為體格和保護慾等原因，往往被誤以為性情凶猛，或是個性冷淡不愛親人但其實只要投入關愛與適當的訓練，這些狗就能發揮真正的本性，成為人類的好伙伴，平反因為傳言或恐懼而產生的壞名聲

programme.title: 狗狗101新把戲第1季:第12集
programme.desc: 在本集中，我們要探討狗被人類馴化的歷史以及牠們的來源主要介紹五大原始犬種，畜牧犬狼型犬視覺型獸獵犬指示犬和獒犬牠們各有各的特點，以及當初原始的培育目的，不過到了現代，育種的目的多半只是為了陪伴人類不管牠們的來源為何，有怎樣的技能，狗都已經成為人類生活中很重要的一部分，永遠伴隨我們左右

programme.desc: 小皮是一隻小腦發育不全的黑色獨眼貓，雖然牠的身體不良於行，跟牠同住的瑞德卻經常遭牠毒打，以至於瑞德經常在外流浪，而主人的室友也因為家裡不安寧而考慮搬家另一家人的貓咪秋天會到處尿尿，破壞了很多電器產品，他們甚至有貓尿物品墳場堆放被牠尿壞或除不掉尿騷味的物件情況嚴重到這家人考慮讓牠永遠待在戶外，可是他們家的後面就是山，有郊狼等野生動物，秋天待在戶外就有生命危險，傑克森要針對個別的問題，為他們管教惡貓

programme.title: 鱷魚拍檔這一家第2季:第2集
programme.desc: 本集中，羅伯特將嘗試第一次和網紋蟒一起游泳，這是澳洲動物園的創舉，也是他父親史帝夫從未做過的事網紋蟒是世上最長的蛇，當牠們咬住目標時，通常咬了就不會放開，然後以蠻力絞纏對方到窒息而死，因此頭一次和網紋蟒一起游泳，讓羅伯特不免有些緊張另外，澳洲動物園內有遼闊的袋鼠區，許多袋鼠都是孤兒，被人類由奶瓶餵養長大，因此不太害怕人類；園內的飼育員必須不眠不休地為小袋鼠餵奶，就像照顧人類嬰兒一樣這天動物醫院收到一隻受傷的楔尾鵰，牠甚至無法飛行，經過兩個多月的照顧和調養，泰瑞終於能將牠野放

programme.title: 百變爬蟲箱第1季:第9集

programme.title: 野地的貓科第1集
programme.desc: 非洲是文明的發源地，住在這裡的動物超過兩百萬種，其中有十種是野地貓科動物，但這些兇猛的野地貓科遭受棲地破壞氣候變化及人類威脅，而被歸類為易危物種

programme.title: 熱血獸醫師第4季:第10集

programme.title: 野性無窮盡第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 節目探究為何有些物種能存活千百年，而另一些生命卻在短短數日內走向終結從決定壽命界限的遺傳機制，到影響生存條件的環境因素，我們將探索塑造生命長度的複雜平衡，畢竟在野外世界中，長壽是一場罕見的勝利野性無窮盡將人類自身的生命旅程，與地球上最長壽及最短命的生命體巧妙對照，引發對生命的思考

programme.title: 珍稀白獅王
programme.desc: 白獅子很稀有，目前全世界僅存大約三百隻，而且全是人工飼養的世界上已經沒有野生白獅子了白獅子珍貴在於牠們並不是因為缺乏黑色素而變成白色，而是本身就有白色基因白獅子在野外生存並不容易，因為牠們全身都很白，缺乏一般獅子的保護色，因此不容易抓到獵物牠們全白的原因可能是因為在上一個冰河時代，非洲還是冰天雪地的時候，全身白反而是保護色白獅子本來已經絕種了但是兩個非洲獅子專家克里斯和傑克，在1970年代，無意間發現三隻小白獅之後，才延續了白獅的命運原來某些黃褐色獅子身上也還帶著白色遺傳因子如果兩隻黃褐色獅子身上都有白因子，那麼牠們交配時，有四分之一的機會會生下白獅子但是有白基因的獅子太少，

programme.title: 霸王龍雷奇第11集

programme.title: 旋風戰車隊第149集

programme.title: 豆豆先生第109集
programme.desc: 在大小銀幕上扮演豆豆先生的羅文亞特金Rowan Atkinson，這次將自己變身為卡通人物，並為這部動畫親自配音！本系列忠實呈現豆豆先生這個活在真實世界的角色，每一集中，我們不幸的豆豆先生，總要大費周章弄得灰頭土臉，才能完成一件簡單的小事，那包括找停車位讓鄰居安靜下來換沙發或是曬曬太陽等豆豆先生忠實的搭檔泰迪和邪惡的房東衛奇太太，以及她的獨眼貓史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾瑪也同台演出這部卡通影集已經在全球150個國家播出，曾經榮獲過國際艾美獎和蒙特婁金玫瑰獎的肯定，並引起豆豆先生的熱潮，改編成同名電影上映

programme.title: 搖滾吧！寶貝第109集
programme.desc: 音樂是一種世界語言，當你在一個語言不通的地方，拿起樂器來哼唱幾句，就能快速連結彼此的心對於正處於語言能力疾速發展的兒童，接觸音樂更能和 語言學習相輔相成已有多項研究證明，讓發育中的幼兒接觸樂器，可以刺激腦部神經，增進創造力，加強耐心及專注力

programme.title: 世上最漂亮的女兒第23集
programme.desc: 經營雪濃湯店的單親媽媽朴善子，含辛茹苦將三個女兒撫養長大大女兒姜美善是標準的職業婦女，在蠟燭兩頭燒的職場與家庭間疲於奔命，不僅要應付強勢挑剔的婆婆，還得將年幼的女兒託付給娘家媽媽照顧二女兒姜美莉是擁有高學歷與高薪的大企業行銷部長，為了不讓母親操心，美莉拚命工作，但在遇上新進職員韓泰柱後，不僅感情迎來轉變，隱藏在身世背後與親生母親的複雜糾葛也逐漸浮上檯面小女兒姜美慧曾是拿過文學獎的天才小說家，如今卻陷入漫長的創作低潮，只能暫時在媽媽的湯店裡幫忙打雜，尋找人生的下一個方向母女間時而爭吵時而相依為命的深厚羈絆，最堅強的後盾，就是媽媽?

programme.title: 花樣少年少女第8集
programme.desc: 盧瑞莃是在美國長大的僑生，因幾年前在電視上看到跳高選手左以泉的跳高特輯，便開始崇拜他為了更了解泉，瑞莃便決心轉校到泉就讀的台灣櫻開學院，但由於櫻開是一所男子學校，瑞莃便扮成男生進入該學校就讀開學的第一天，瑞莃因為班機誤點而遲到慌慌張張的她像瘋了般飛奔跑進學校而撞上了泉，可是她還不知道她撞到的人就是泉瑞莃的書被撞至掉到整地都是，她匆忙地撿起了書本之後又飛奔而去，可是把書包遺留在地上到了教室之後，瑞莃才發現地丟了書包這時，泉走進來把書包丟在了瑞莃的懷裏，並諷刺地說：沒想到你腿短短的，跑起來還挺快的嘛下課後，瑞莃走到泉的面前，鞠了一躬後向泉表白她喜歡泉，並想和他做朋友泉的第一想法

programme.desc: 一部充滿浪漫與青春氣息的愛情劇，講述了兩位年輕人穿越困難與誤解，最終找到彼此的故事劇中展現了愛情的堅持與成長，讓人感受到溫暖與希望

programme.title: 台灣百味第459集
programme.desc: 在人群攘往熙來的繁華街道裡，有個老味道靜靜記錄著時間流逝那或許是來自家鄉的味道，也或許是和家人共處的幸福味道，當然也有可能是乘載夢想的味道台灣百味將帶您探索這些存在於台灣各處的味道，不僅讓您用美味一餐滿足飢腸轆轆，也用快樂的養分滋養心生命

programme.title: 台灣百廟第322集
programme.desc: 每一座老廟，都擁有在地發展最初始的記憶；每一炷香火，都滿載鄉親里民最虔誠的心意百年來香火不斷，世代間信仰不歇，寒來暑往，流轉著許多動人的故事與傳奇台灣百廟帶您悠遊台灣各處宮廟，發現最在地的民間故事，品嚐最道地的庶民小吃，體驗最特別的民俗風情，探索最深植人心的宮廟文化給您最不同以往的行腳文化之旅

programme.title: 那座城這家人第20集
programme.desc: 講述了王大鳴楊艾在地震中痛失所愛，二人結成半路夫妻，最終組成了一個由七個姓組成的九口之家，相互扶持擺脫困境重建家園的故事

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之英雄有夢
programme.desc: 這個故事主要聚焦於黃飛鴻成為宗師之前的艱苦戰鬥與磨練，具有前傳的特質1868年，清朝末期，政府的腐敗使得民眾生活困苦在廣州，黑虎幫和北海幫兩大惡勢力在黃埔港肆無忌憚地活動他們以暴力威脅掌控港口的貧苦百姓，使其生活在水深火熱之中外界看似黃埔港是繁榮且充滿機會的地方，但深入了解後會發現，這裡實際上是人間地獄黑虎幫的首領雷公因一名新進手下阿飛的過人武藝和膽略，成功挑戰了北海幫的首領，使黑虎幫獨占鳌头，不僅藉由鴉片獲得巨額利益，還進行卑劣的人口販賣雷公對阿飛視如己出但實際上，阿飛背後隱藏著另有故事，心中也有著其他計畫他與志同道合的朋友們設下圈套，拯救貧苦的人們，並公開挑戰雷公，展開生死

programme.title: 歲月風雲之上海皇帝
programme.desc: 麥當雄與蕭若元（編劇）潘文傑（導演）呂良偉與鄭則仕（男主角）的組合，曾推出了港產黑道人物傳記片經典跛豪，掀起了一片黑白兩道傳記片風潮如今，原班人馬遠赴上海開拍民國近代史梟雄杜月笙的故事，名為歲月風雲之上海皇帝杜月笙（呂良偉飾）本是小販出身，因用流氓手法偵破國民黨領袖被刺真相，聲名大噪，受到法租界總探長（鄭則士飾）賞識，從此平步青雲，依附軍閥勢力，逐步攀升成為上海大亨

programme.title: 攔截聲命線

programme.title: 雞不可失
programme.desc: 韓國影史最賣座喜劇雞不可失電影從頭到尾精心鋪陳笑點，不僅讓觀眾笑開懷成為紓壓首選，由影帝柳承龍性感女星李哈妮實力派演員陳善圭新生代男星李東輝和當紅小鮮肉孔明共組的魯蛇緝毒組，搞笑毫無包袱認真又可愛的模樣更獲得廣大觀眾喜愛大受歡迎的喜劇雞不可失不只紅了炸雞，魯蛇緝毒組的成員們也跟著人氣飆升，讓影迷看完電影上網狂搜其中戲裡擁有黑皮膚小鬍子的李東輝和熱血呆萌的菜鳥孔明，戲外竟分別是眼鏡潮男和鮮肉花美男，真面目讓影迷又驚又喜引起瘋狂爆笑好評及無敵炸雞旋風的超強喜劇電影雞不可失巧妙運用了草根精神與不被看好的小人物趣味設定，來讓普遍觀眾都能感同身受，融合了動作人物笑聲和感動，

programme.title: 退休追殺令

programme.title: 賭俠1999

programme.title: 乒乓男孩

programme.title: 大行動
programme.desc: 重案組神探黃維邦（李子雄飾）因手患不便持槍，而打算暫時離職，但此時警方線人謝卻在大馬離奇被殺，黃乃謝之好友，亦曾受其救命之恩，遂決意接手此案黃連同重案組同仁倫國強（黃衍濛飾）阿金（郭追飾）及大馬警察翁振富（盧景華飾）組成專案小組辦理此案，根據線索向疑兇富商賀加年（翁世傑飾）著手展開調查，原來此案幕後主謀乃是香港名流韓政（朱江飾），黃雖已掌握證人賀，但此時賀卻突然遇襲被殺，黃遭韓誣陷貪污，其未婚妻Maggie（麥翠嫻飾）更因發現韓販毒秘密而慘遭人殺害黃悲憤不已，卻又苦於無有力證據一日，倫巧遇韓手下殺手，跟蹤之下以竊聽器錄得韓之犯罪證據，但不慎為韓所擒，雖倫女友Ada（王祖賢飾）已極召黃等

programme.title: 暴雨驕陽

programme.title: 傲氣雄鷹
programme.desc: 為了應對愈發嚴重的犯罪形勢，香港警方組建精英部隊BOB，向警隊內部廣泛招攬人才神槍手李建華（劉德華飾）為人自信技術過硬，甘冒風險解除了一次人質危機，雖然做事莽撞被上司批評，但也如願和好友阿偉（苗僑偉飾）一起獲得了加入BOB的機會BOB之教官Miss唐（關之琳飾）令李建華一見鍾情，在嚴苛的訓練之餘不忘對其大膽追求不久，一越南犯罪團伙赴港綁架人質，李建華與隊友們奉命出擊，首次行動就旗開得勝，然而這批匪徒只是掩護，真正的越南犯罪集團IBS正在暗處籌劃刺殺政要，BOB再次出擊，這次他們遭遇了真正的考驗

programme.title: 神探蒲松齡
programme.desc: 傳說很久以前，人間突然闖進了許多妖怪，萬妖之王派出捉妖大師蒲松齡（成龍 飾）化身神探，誓要將妖怪捉回！途中蒲松齡利用神器陰陽判收伏妖怪，並得到妖怪朋友們的幫助，在捉妖過程中結識了捕快嚴飛（林柏宏 飾），並著手調查村內少女接連離奇失蹤事件，發現是女妖聶小倩（鍾楚曦 飾）及鏡妖（林鵬 飾）所為蒲松齡趕到少女失蹤現場，捉妖獵人燕赤霞（阮經天 飾）正與二妖打鬥蒲松齡收伏了鏡妖，並把燕赤霞救回聊齋原來聶小倩本是人類少女，與善良的青麟蛇妖寧采臣相戀，寧采臣以妖丹換取小倩的影子，卻遭一場災劫，令妖丹見血受污，聶小倩成了噬魂奪魄的妖怪一個天職收妖，遇上一對奇情佳偶，蒲松齡會否將他們收伏？

programme.title: 大話神探
programme.desc: 名模戴李察原為名噪一時之大盜，後來和拍檔阿蕊協議金盆洗手，而阿蕊亦轉而從良，下嫁刑事偵緝警官吳超人李察有一侄子志偉，欲得盜竊的秘訣，但為所拒，無奈志偉卻不罷休. 另一方面，指揮官胡處長安排超人及當紅幹探衝鋒車，以一顆幾可亂真之寶石，由衝鋒車以歸僑身份，擺設酒會，實行佈下香餌釣金鰲. 當衝鋒車公開展示寶石之際，志偉果然心癢難忍，在混亂中，將寶石盜取. 結果引起一場喧然大波衝鋒車奪回寶石，施計以綁票局陷李察入局，並將李察拘捕. 後來志偉保釋李察並重回警署插贓嫁禍超人，竟然被警員知道，便將計就計，引其上鉤，結果李察叔侄中計，二人在突圍時，竟誤闖胡處長之升官派對，頓時場面一片混亂，爭持之下，寶石脫

programme.title: 阿飛正傳
programme.desc: 1960年代的香港，因生母在阿飛旭仔（張國榮）長大成人過程中的缺失，他把自己優雅地比喻為無根鳥，對生命中遇到的每一個女人都表現得放蕩不羈，售票員蘇麗珍（張曼玉）和舞女咪咪（劉嘉玲）先後令他感受過溫暖，可是她們也只能噹噹小情人為擺脫沉重和無力感，旭仔拋下一切去南洋找尋生母暗戀過蘇麗珍且目睹過她與旭仔情感一路變化的，曾是小巡警今在跑船的超仔（劉德華）在菲律賓又遇到旭仔，是緣分也是宿命，他參與見證了阿飛命運被改寫的過程

programme.title: 火鍋英雄
programme.desc: 三個老同學劉波（陳坤 飾）許東（秦昊 飾）和王平川（喻恩泰 飾）在重慶的一個廢棄防空洞裡合夥經營一家洞子火鍋由於餐館生意冷清，三人打算將其重新裝修以高價轉賣在一次拓展門面時，三人意外打通了一條通往銀行金庫的隧道因擔心惹上麻煩，他們尋求在銀行工作的老同學於小慧（白百何 飾）的幫助，試圖在銀行發現前填好洞口然而，因爛賭而揹負外債的劉波難以抵抗誘惑，在一念之差下決定鋌而走險，暗自從金庫中取出現金作為賭本，希望可以贏錢還清外債

programme.title: 無價之保
programme.desc: 劇情描述討債大叔頭石（成東鎰 飾）宗培（金希沅 飾），無法順利讓單親媽媽還債，便將她10歲女兒承怡（朴昭怡／河智苑 飾）當作擔保品帶走！然而，當他們發現單親媽媽因非法移民被遣送，逼不得以只好照料被遺棄的承怡從這一天起，擔保品成了寶貝，展開一場養成萌孩的溫馨催淚之旅！本片由國民爸爸成東鎰，攜手帶輪子的人好友拍檔金希沅，共同演出暖心爆笑的討債大叔，由魔鬼對決童星朴昭怡飾演片中超萌寶貝，睽違多時的韓劇天后河智苑更回歸大銀幕演出！電影宛如包裹著喜劇糖衣的親情催淚彈，韓國上映首周更創下70億票房佳績，動人情節更哭翻百萬觀眾！

programme.title: 夜驚魂
programme.desc: 性感女星袁晶（唐一菲飾）頻遭不明人士偷窺與匿名電話騷擾，遂找來律師出身的私家偵探喬涼（林雨申飾）展開調查，卻一無所獲此時，一部為袁晶量身打造的古裝恐怖片紅花淚邀其參演，為躲避侵擾，袁晶索性答應接拍，趕赴拍攝地安徽某廢棄的古村落戲內戲外的致命險情現實夢境的索命追魂不可解釋的鬼魂附身，靈異事件繼續接二連三發生在所有人面臨崩潰束手無策時，喬涼忽然發現，在袁晶這個多情善感的女明星背後，隱藏著鬼秘莫測的前塵往事

programme.title: 千鈞一髮
programme.desc: 和大多数平平常常注定一生毫無起色的中國人一樣，在此之前，老魚過着拮据，鎖碎的市井生活，雖然他的職業是一個警察突如其来的炸弹事件讓老魚的落魄人生得以風生雲起，接着，这個街區的命運也得以改變這個城市的命運也隨之改變就在老魚祖代生活的街區隔壁的一幢一百年前的猶太人老建築裡，警方發现了一枚炸弹，專家遠在雲南難以趕来，自製炸弹的不確定性又讓警方不知如何下手，因為當過二十四年的兵，懂炸药，懂電的，正在一如既往去鑿冰取魚的老魚被半途喚回，臨陣點將老魚也被眼前的情景嚇了一跳，再過不到一個小時就要爆炸，老建築均為木質结構，私搭的煤氣管道通往街區的四周高大建築，施爆者身份踪跡不明危機一觸即發眾目睽睽之

programme.title: 我在死牢的日子
programme.desc: 阿潮阿文和亞森三人在死牢相逢，三人犯案原因不同，個性不同，結局也不同阿潮在神會上是角頭老大，一言九鼎，因為幫派爭奪地盤原故，被迫在廟宇持械連殺三人，被判死刑在死牢內，阿潮仍然貝備道上大哥的風範，成為牢內是非的仲裁者阿文個性魯莽剛直，重情重義，但也因此一個性使然，幫好友催討債，卻成擄人勒索，由於羈押期間脫逃，罪上加罪，也被判死刑亞森為武俠作字，典型書生本色，但因度蜜月回國通關時，被栽贓藏毒，也被發配死牢亞森個性溫文，初時無法適應死牢被剝自由和生命尊嚴的生活，但後來與阿潮阿文朝夕相處，心情才趨穩定，並對牢內死囚萌發同情心，三人在牢中稱兄道弟亞森初進死牢，被阿潮喝令脫衣褲檢查身上有無

programme.title: 武士
programme.desc: 出使明朝的高麗使節團，因高麗與明朝的關係惡化，而遭到流放，流放期間遭受元朝騎兵攻擊，元軍將明軍全數殲滅，並將高麗人留在大漠戈壁自生自滅原先的決定，是一起越過沙漠返回高麗，但為首的高麗將軍崔正不甘揹負失敗歸鄉，在年老的副使節死後，獨斷的決定要救出被擄的明朝芙蓉公主，為明朝立功以完成任務，在救出公主後，又在渡口被遭元軍屠殺的居民跟上，除了保護公主，他們還要護送一批居民在幾次的對決中，將軍崔正旗下的龍虎旗，幾乎全軍覆沒時，被弓箭手陳立所領軍的忠義旗及副使節賜其自由的奴隸所救，將軍崔正的威信及其決定遭受到嚴重的質疑，改由陳立領導大家並接受公主的條件，展開下一段旅程，思鄉的高麗人與失去家人的漢人譜寫

programme.title: 新宿事件
programme.desc: 新宿事件的故事發生在1990年代，成龍飾演的苦力勞工鐵頭，冒著生命危險偷渡到日本為了找尋到日本留學的青梅竹馬女友秀秀徐靜蕾飾演鐵頭在日本投靠同村好友阿傑吳彥祖飾演，與其他的偷渡一起窩在一處大雜院，成為日本社會中最低層的人他們辛勤工作但是生活物價的壓力卻壓得他們喘不過氣正當鐵頭想要放棄尋找秀秀的念頭，赫然發現她已經成為日本黑幫三和會副會長的妻子，並且育有一女鐵頭斷了念，決定在日本落地生根好好過日子，此時他也在夜店裡認識了媽媽桑麗麗范冰冰飾演因為偷渡客在當地無法從事正當職業，為了生存，鐵頭說服阿傑一起開始搞起不法勾當，他們一群人的勢力也慢慢的茁壯沒想到某天阿傑卻

programme.title: 警賊黑白衝
programme.desc: 刑警趙修光脾氣火爆，拳頭總是動得比嘴巴快，儘管他的逮捕成績斐然，卻常常憤怒失控對嫌犯動粗，因此而聲名狼藉的他被調到了濟州島...與此同時，韓國最厲害的詐欺師金仁海也將濟州島視為下一個犯罪目標然而，當海外黑幫勢力入侵濟州島，企圖控制當地商業區並將其變成毒品交易中心時，趙修光和金仁海不得不暫時放下對彼此的敵意，共同對抗黑幫老大周麟方

programme.title: 小親親

programme.title: 騙神！騙鬼！金先達
programme.desc: 天才般的智謀和當今第一厚臉皮!兼具獨特胸懷和俊俏外型的傑出天才大騙子金先達兪承豪飾神出鬼沒!只要一出現就能創造傳奇的金先達總是等待著一場人生大騙局，他和喬裝達人普願高昌錫 飾，掠奪占卜費專家尹菩薩羅美蘭 飾，詐騙未來之星堅兒Xiumin 飾一起展開各種異想天開的詐欺行為，並且以朝鮮第一詐騙團揚名朝鮮八道當他們正在籌備在朝鮮以最高價成交的淡婆姑香菸掠奪計畫時，得知其幕後藏鏡人竟然是當代最高掌權者成大聯曹在鉉 飾，於是為了騙他上鉤，以沒有物主的大同江做誘餌，策劃了人生大騙局

programme.title: 使徒行者
programme.desc: 臥底阿釘（佘詩曼 飾）收到一個只有警方臥底才懂的康氏密碼打出的神秘訊息，一個自稱Blackjack的臥底表示跟警隊失聯，她隨即報告上司Q Sir（吳鎮宇 飾），尋找臥底行動立即展開尋找Blackjack的過程裡，阿釘被引到賭場，竟發現當年被槍殺的覃歡喜死而復生同一時間，Q Sir查得某商業集團暗中牽涉了一宗巴西毒品交易，讓他漸漸找出Blackjack可能的身份而牽涉毒品交易的人物包括：集團主席郭銘，謀臣藍博文（張家輝 飾），他的搭檔劭志朗（古天樂 飾），以及想要東山再起的覃歡喜等人此時，各人開始知曉有臥底潛伏，集團人人開始猜疑，人人自危

programme.title: 帝國浩劫-美國內戰
programme.desc: 在反烏托邦的未來美國，一支隨軍記者團隊在反叛勢力攻陷白宮前與時間賽跑，急速趕往華盛頓特區

programme.title: 小小兵
programme.desc: 從單細胞黃色有機體演化而成的小小兵，人生的意義就是服侍最邪惡的主人但從暴龍一直到拿破崙，他們持續失去這些主人，最後甚至因找不到人服侍而陷入深深的憂鬱然而其中一名小小兵凱文有了計策，他聯合叛逆的史都華以及可愛的小蘿蔔展開帶領他們尋找可能的新主人-史嘉蕾．殺很大，世上第一個女性超級惡棍的冒險旅程

programme.title: 刺客聯盟
programme.desc: 這部由安潔莉娜裘麗摩根費利曼主演的精采動作影片,觀眾絕不可錯過! 衛斯理是個不得志的宅男，連女友都跟好友一起背叛他有天他遇到性感火辣的火狐，帶領他走進一個前所未見的世界衛斯從她口中得知他幾乎遺忘的父親在替刺客聯盟出任務時不幸遭到殺害刺客聯盟是一個有百年歷史的組織，專門訓練擁有超異能的刺客，誓死服從刺客聯盟的鐵律，而他們的座右銘則是：刺殺一人，拯救千人現在衛斯理必須追隨他父親的腳步，解放蘊藏在他內心已久的超級能量但是這個組織是否真如其首領所宣稱，具有正義的使命呢？

programme.title: 淘氣小兵兵
programme.desc: 淘氣的小兵兵又來了! 這一次查基由克莉絲汀卡瓦諾配音一心一意想找個新媽媽，而正巧他的父親蔡斯又重拾約會生涯了說到約會，巴黎這個浪漫都市可稱得上是首選，因此一家人便浩浩蕩蕩地往巴黎出發就在此時，史都皮克也被征召到巴黎的一個遊樂園，進行一項新發明原本一趟浪漫的巴黎之行，並不如查基想像中順利，而他的父親蔡斯也終於嚐到戀愛的苦頭，並深深體會到，不論世界各地，所有陷入愛河的人，都必須靠自己好好經營才是淘氣小兵兵第二集，挾帶著第一集超人氣的威力，又將掀起動畫界的一番熱潮

programme.desc: 好萊塢好好看每週將播出三部強檔電影的拍攝花絮及演員和導演的訪問

programme.desc: 年輕的非裔美籍男子克里斯丹尼爾卡盧亞飾前去白人女友愛莉森威廉絲飾的老家拜訪，卻發現這個邀約不過是要引誘他進入邪惡的圈套中克里斯一開始將女友家人過於熱情的態度解讀為對女兒與不同種族的人談戀愛感到緊張然而隨著週末活動持續的進行，一連串擾人的事件讓他發現一個自己無法想像的真相這齣推理驚悚片出自布倫屋製片公司探訪陰兒房系列電影靈異大逆轉與導演喬登皮爾之手，劇情不但扣人心弦，更具有強烈的話題性

programme.title: 黃金羅盤

programme.title: 哈利波特-死神的聖物II

programme.title: 馴龍高手

programme.title: 黃金之地
programme.desc: 第一代旁遮普卡車司機基蘭即將成為一名父親但他不負責的態度使周遭親近的人與之疏遠有一天他無意中聽到後車廂有敲擊聲，發現裡面藏了一個身無證件的女孩艾琳娜，之後一切都發生了變化，他開始開車尋找她的家人在這段艱難的旅程中，兩人一邊躲避警察，一邊因音樂油漆樣本以及在美國白人中被視為異類的含義而爭吵卻又結下不解之緣本片對團結差異與家庭有深刻的世俗審視，充滿了內心信念和力量，最大限度地發揮了前提的潛力，總和成更偉大的片子

programme.desc: 歐利是在大都市裡工作的一名事業有成的公關高手，過著完美的人生，沒想到竟出現意外的轉折，讓他成為無業的單親爸爸，回到郊區投靠父親正當他認為自己的人生已跌落谷底之時，性感一絲不苟的錄影帶店員走進他的生活，讓他明白有時人必須忘掉自以為是的過往，接受現在真正讓你快樂的人事物

programme.title: 進擊的大佬
programme.desc: 勞勃狄尼洛和席維斯史特龍飾演一對拳擊場上的宿敵，兩人比完最後一場比賽後就要退休他們彼此在全盛時期都曾打贏過對方，然而在1983年關鍵性的第三次決戰前夕，剃刀突然宣布退休，他堅決不肯透露原因，此舉卻立刻為他們兩人的拳擊生涯畫下休止符30年後，拳擊賽的承辦人小丹堤史雷特嗅到賺大錢的好機會，提出一個讓他們無法拒絕的提議：回到拳擊場上，最後一次一決勝負

programme.title: 馴龍高手
programme.desc: 本動畫以奇幻世界為背景，描述強壯的維京人和野生龍族間的精彩動作冒險故事主角小嗝嗝在部落中顯得格格不入，這裡長久以來的傳統就是將屠龍者視為大英雄當小嗝嗝遇見一隻龍之後，他的世界就變得完全不同這隻龍挑戰了他和他的維京同胞們過去的世界觀，讓他們從截然不同的角度了解這個世界

programme.title: 變形金剛5-最終騎士
programme.desc: 大導演麥可貝和執行製作人史蒂芬史匹柏聯手帶來這齣最大製作情節最具爆炸性的變形金鋼續集柯博文為了拯救賽博坦，打算摧毀地球，這個曾是世界上最偉大的英雄，如今變成最兇狠的敵人現在大黃蜂與凱德伊格馬克華柏格飾必須率領變形金剛與昔日盟友決一死戰以避免人類被消滅

programme.title: 限制級戰警-重返極限

programme.title: 鋼鐵擂台
programme.desc: 然而，這個計畫卻因為他從未見過的11歲兒子麥斯到來而被打斷，他不想要收留這個孩子，但為了錢，只好勉為其難與他一同生活同時，查理遇上被人丟棄的爛鐵機器人亞當，亞當其實只是訓練專用的機器人，所以可以承受強力的撞擊，但卻對拳擊打鬥一竅不通於是，查理決定好好訓練它，並將他的拳擊技巧全教授給亞當，希望可以攜手拿下冠軍他們在地下拳擊場展開一場場的決鬥，並朝著冠軍邁進，就在查理進行對機器人的訓練同時，他與兒子的關係也越來越親密

programme.title: 分秒幣爭
programme.desc: 1997年，亞洲金融風暴，韓國經濟面臨空前危機，距離國家破產還剩下一周之時，韓國銀行貨幣政策經理韓詩賢（金惠秀飾）提前預測到國家即將遭遇這重大經濟危機財經顧問尹正學（劉亞仁 飾）也觀察到這場風暴即將來臨，他決定逆向操作，趁機賭上一筆，大發國難財同時，小工廠老闆岬秀（許俊浩 飾）與大型零售商簽下巨額合約，卻不知一場政府都支撐不住的金融風暴即將襲捲而來...韓詩賢在摸索突破的方法時，卻面對來自長官（趙宇鎮 飾）及各方權力系統高層的壓力，眼見國家政策決定放棄經濟自主權，向IMF（國際貨幣基金組織）主席（文森卡索 飾）求助，她要如何堅守信念，力挽狂瀾？

programme.title: 刺客密令
programme.desc: 世界頂尖的契約殺手安娜，誓言要找出殺害傳奇刺客穆迪的幕後黑手，要他血債血償！她與神祕殺手林布蘭展開一場致命的貓捉老鼠遊戲

programme.title: 全民公敵
programme.desc: 家庭事業有成的律師勞勃克雷頓迪恩（威爾史密斯 飾），巧遇一位久未謀面的朋友，他狼狽地央求勞勃救他，並在倉惶中拿了勞勃的名片後，便行色匆匆地逃跑了就在他橫越馬路時，意外地發生車禍，當場死亡，此時勞勃已陷入一個難以脫身的謀殺案中，卻渾然不覺因為車禍喪生的友人，早已神不知鬼不覺地，將一張記錄著一樁國會議員謀殺的磁碟片，放在他的袋子裡原來謀殺國會議員的主謀湯馬斯雷諾茲（強沃特 飾）和他的屬下，當時為了取回磁碟片，正追殺著勞勃的朋友，而他們在車禍現場找到了勞勃的名片後，開始尋線跟蹤他用高科技的衛星監視，企圖嚴密控制勞勃的行蹤，藉以奪回磁碟片銷毀謀殺的證據，並殺人滅口家庭事業與生命受到極大威脅

programme.desc: 名為分隊的政府秘密情報單位，募集了一群擁有超能力基因的人來進行實驗，目的是增進他們的力量，組織史上空前的超異能大軍，可惜幾乎沒人能存活到實驗的最後尼克甘特（克里斯伊凡飾演）是第二代的心靈傳動超異能戰士，又稱為靈動人，自從分隊在十幾年前殺了他父親之後，他就一直四處躲藏，藏匿在人口稠密的香港13歲擁有透視能力的凱西荷姆斯（達柯塔芬妮飾演），又稱為透視人，她要找一只她宣稱內有600萬美元現鈔的手提箱，於是她向尼克求援，逼得尼克不得不現身協助為了找到那只手提箱，他們還要再找到琪拉（卡蜜拉貝兒飾演）相助，她是一位逃亡的推手，也是分隊實驗的唯一倖存者推手擁有超異能者中，

programme.title: 玩命關頭5

programme.desc: 迷戀中國功夫崇拜李小龍的17歲美國小男生傑森（麥可安格蘭諾飾），大概是世界上除了昆汀塔倫提諾之外，收集最多功夫電影的粉絲了！一個夏日，這個十七歲的男孩騎著腳踏車，到波士頓唐人街的一家當鋪，尋找具有收藏價值的中國功夫片，但他總是在穿過自己家附近的巷子時遇到麻煩，因為傑森經常被一群混混盯上，並且常受到他們的欺負傑森精通電子遊戲，對於功夫片也是如數家珍，他總是希望自己也能成為一名功夫高手，然而當鋪的老闆老霍卻認為，傑森根本不是這塊料，他根本不知道什麼是功夫這天，傑森偶然在當鋪裡面發現了一根神秘的金箍棒，竟然因此穿越無門之門來到了古代的中國！他發現自己已經置身於一個驚世預言中：一個使者要將傳

programme.title: 轟天綁票令
programme.desc: 三角洲部隊成員維克奉派保護支持擁槍案的參議員，途中遇到匪徒襲擊並被人肉炸彈爆破衝擊；某日，維克到大學宿舍接兒子西恩返家，發覺法官之女艾琳的司機和校工們行跡可疑於是維克趁艾琳回房間拿筆電時，要求致電其父肯派員狀況，同時司機下令直接綁架艾琳並殺害維克和西恩，同時中情局局長麥克向肯表示已綁架艾琳，逼迫於法院時支持主張議案之後維克帶西恩和艾琳逃脫追殺並反擊匪徒，接著西恩和艾琳被同學陷害交給匪徒綁架後，維克向肯尋求支援而到囚禁基地拯救兩人並殲滅匪徒，最終麥克離開基地返家被司機殺害

programme.desc: 海克力士，是希臘神話裡有名的半人半神的英雄，因此他一出生便力大無比在戰爭喧鬧之際，父皇將她心愛的女子許配給他的兄長，更設計派遣海克力士率兵打仗；海克力士失望透頂，喪失鬥志，部隊潰不成軍戰敗淪為奴隸經歷許久的顛沛流離，海克力士承受諸多苦難，也結交到許多盟友，沉潛多時後，他再度率領騎兵重返國境，奪回心愛的女子

programme.title: 少林足球
programme.desc: 青年阿星（周星馳 飾）熱愛武術並擁有異於常人的腿力，在他遇上素有黃金右腳之稱已過氣的瘸腿足球明星明峰（吳孟達 飾）後，阿星的足球天份才被發掘；擔任教練的明峰力邀大力金剛腿阿星及少林五祖的師兄弟共組一支少林隊，以便參加全國超級盃足球大賽過程中，阿星與一名奇醜無比卻能以太極拳法做包子饅頭的奇女子阿梅（趙薇 飾）相識，極度缺乏自信的阿梅在阿星千方百計的鼓舞下，終於嘗試改變自已的人生此時阿星和其他足球隊員在比賽中遭遇了前所未有的強勁對手魔鬼隊，他們要如何擊敗強敵贏得勝利呢？

programme.title: 南北戰爭傳奇

programme.title: 第三類外星人25週年紀念版
programme.desc: 東尼的父親山姆被外星人綁架三年後，他回到地球尋找妻子和兒子，但妻子此時已與他人同居經過一場尷尬的重逢後，山姆的妻子意識到他已經不再是離開前的那個人，而山姆也開始以令人恐懼的方式影響東尼

programme.title: 出竅遇見愛
programme.desc: 人在死後要追尋愛情絕非易事你一定會認為死了以後，就不必再面對日常生活中的瑣事和處理煩人的愛情其實沒這麼好！就像麥克安迪卡爾飾所發現，就算死了也沒能得到釋放當他從車禍現場被抬出來時，發現自己與一位陌生女子克莉絲汀娜蕾奇飾，阿達一族她和他和他們之間在一間非常明亮的屋子裡時，他得知如果要讓自己的靈魂能夠搭乘下一班飛機，需要找到一名伴侶諾拉艾妮詹德飾，查克史奈德執導，即將上映的活屍大軍如果你覺得活著的時候約會很難，那在死了以後會更困難麥克現在才想搞清楚那些複雜的規則什麼事該做，什麼事不該做，以及為自己的靈魂做什麼，會不會為時已晚？

programme.desc: 一位具備廚藝背景的食譜經紀人，受命協助一位以便利料理聞名的美食頻道名人提升品牌形象在共同籌備新食譜書的過程中，兩人從食材到口味處處鬥嘴火花四射隨著合作深入，經紀人發現自己不僅要在專業與創意之間抉擇，更必須在遵循規則與傾聽內心之間做出選擇她究竟會選擇照著食譜走，還是勇敢追隨自己的心？

programme.title: CEO的禮物
programme.desc: 美麗的凱瑟琳在頂級投資公司面試金融交易員時，英俊的公司CEO保羅當場錄用了她，並有意將她培養為公司頂尖人才他對凱瑟琳不僅在事業上格外關照，還展開了浪漫追求，兩人很快就墜入愛河，保羅不斷送上禮物和特別的關心一切看似美好直到某次公司聚會後的清晨，凱瑟琳獨自醒來，身處保羅奢華的豪宅當她下樓時，卻發現保羅的前妻死在客廳裡！

programme.title: 西遊記女兒國
programme.desc: 唐僧一行人前去西天取經，不料闖進神秘的西梁女國一個從未有過男人的國家女兒國國王對唐僧一見鍾情，卻因不知情為何物自以為患上是絕症，國師警告國王男人乃劇毒生物，並下令處死唐僧一行人師徒四人在國王的協助下逃離法場就在孫悟空施展72變解救師徒三人時，唐僧似也打爛齋砵對國王漸生情愫講述了1941年抗日戰爭期間，鐵道工人們利用自己的工作經驗成功阻擊日軍突襲，並為百姓的奪取生存補給的傳奇經歷，成龍將在電影中出演足智多謀的鐵道遊擊隊隊長

programme.title: 殺戮公園
programme.desc: 1978年，薇薇安因銀行搶劫案失手，被兩名逃犯劫持為人質然而，當她和劫持者最終來到一個精神失常的退伍軍人狙擊手駐紮的烈日炎炎的沙漠前哨時，情況急轉直下，陷入了瘋狂的貓捉老鼠遊戲

programme.title: 英雄本色2018
programme.desc: 周凱參與走私，被身為緝毒員警的弟弟週超逮捕入獄三年後，周凱出獄，改過自新曾經的手下阿倉已為毒販頭目，為獲取周凱的海外客戶資料，設計加害周凱周凱與警方合作，逮捕了阿倉，兩兄弟重歸於好

programme.title: 混混天團

programme.title: 蘭開斯特戰役
programme.desc: 1943年，從大不列顛戰役生還失去親弟弟的飛官道格拉斯米勒，調職為轟炸機司令，感到生氣心碎孤獨的他，下定決心要拿下德國的領空然而，原先擔任這職位的人在轟炸機部隊中廣受愛戴，卻在出任務時犧牲，使得新官上任的道格拉斯，在報復心切的同時，還得費盡苦心與新隊員建立關係他只能努力戰勝心魔，並成為稱職的領袖

programme.title: 我的另一面

programme.title: 侏儸紀大逃殺

programme.title: 戰狼部隊-戰略機密

programme.title: 天使營救
